field_values.redo_desc_about:
Spirit of Darwin Territory Day Fireworks Cruise
Get ready for an enchanting Wednesday night under the stars as Darwin Harbour lights up with the magic of Territory Day fireworks! Celebrate from the best seat in the harbour — with no sand, no crowds, and no stress. Enjoy a reserved table for your group, cold drinks from the bar, onboard toilets, easy parking, and amazing fireworks views. We’ll cruise through Darwin Harbour with live commentary, serve a delicious buffet dinner, then anchor near Mindil Beach for the official fireworks display. Dessert will be served on the way back to Stokes Hill Wharf. Join in the fun with our lucky number raffle for a chance to win cash prizes, all supporting the wonderful work of Variety - the Children's Charity. Come aboard for a fun, feel-good night filled with fireworks, harbour views, great food, and memories to last a lifetime.

459312.raw_desc:
description: #Improve your riding with an Experienced Coach in a Group 

##Duration
1 Hour

##About
An intermediate rider has control at walk and trot and has begun to develop their position and balance, starting to canter. 
You can also bring your own horse. Please indicate in the comments section if you would like to bring your own horse. 

##Clothing Requirements 
Arion Riding Centre can supply helmets and riding boots if you do not have your own. An approved safety helmet is compulsory when riding and is recommended when children are handling ponies. Footwear must be suitable and safe, both for riding and when working around ponies. Jodhpur boots are ideal, or failing this, solid boots with a smooth sole and solid heel. Boots with cleated soles or shoes without heels are unsuitable. Long pants must be worn and tops must be suitable and at minimum cover the shoulders. Singlets or shorts are not permitted.
459312.raw_booking:
By booking this lesson you are over the age of 18 years and have confirmed any personal details are correct. No personal information will be shared but will be kept on file for health and safety. If it is your first-time riding at Arion Riding Centre, you will need to fill out and sign [this form.](https://form.jotform.com/230227365961053)

We supply helmets and riding boots if you do not have your own.

Please arrive 15min before your lesson to help with tacking up your horse, checking your stirrup length and mounting your horse before your lesson time begins. 

Do you need to reschedule or cancel your appointment? Please contact us.

We look forward to seeing you at Arion Riding Centre

Looking to work on your riding and horsemanship? Want to build your confidence and prepare yourself to get the most out of your future horse riding holidays?....... but still looking for a fun and indulgent holiday experience? Well, we think we have the answer. Spend fours days focused on you and your equestrian skills at Junction Farm, where the rider education facilities including a state of the art Racewood Eventing Simulator and beautiful 90m x 60m polo turf arena are coupled with iconic Tasmanian scenery, clean open spaces and country hospitality.
Breed of Horse: Arabian, Arabian Cross, Waler Cross, Morgan Cross
Contact Us: Special group charter tours available on request.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights: Your lessons will be on the famous Australian Horse Adventures trekking team, naturally educated for bitless barefoot riding, and they will focus on how to get the most out of these fabulous, spirited horses. Junction Farm Equestrian Park's, experienced and dedicated team of instructors will give you hours of instructed riding, trail, horsemanship and Racewood Eventing Simulator time to not only build you ability, confidence and joy in riding but set you up for even greater horse riding adventures ahead. All this together with the renowned Australian Horse Adventures hospitality.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: This all inclusive package includes four days' riding and three nights’ accommodation, all meals and drinks, plus daily transfers from your accommodation to Junction Farm.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Day 1: Pick up, horse introduction, lessons, simulator practice, dinner at accommodation. Day 2: Breakfast, training sessions, simulator time, snacks, lunch, dinner at accommodation. Day 3: Specialist clinic, drinks, dinner with instructor. Day 4: Trail ride at Junction Farm, afternoon tea, wrap-up, drop off in Launceston or at the airport.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
- Suitable riding footwear
- Flat soled riding boots & short chaps or long riding boots
- Comfortable riding pants
- Riding tights or jodphurs are ideal, but or close fitting flexible pants are fine.
- Long sleeved shirts
- Waterproof jacket
- Waterproof pants
- Casual clothing and footwear for evenings
- Gloves
- Sunscreen
- Personal items including toiletries and medication
- A “fancy” outfit for dining out
- Riding Helmet

#This all inclusive package includes four days' riding and three nights’ accommodation

##Duration 
4 days, 3 nights

##About 
Looking to work on your riding and horsemanship? Want to build your confidence and prepare yourself to get the most out of your future horse riding holidays?....... but still looking for a fun and indulgent holiday experience?

Well, we think we have the answer.

Spend fours days focused on you and your equestrian skills at Junction Farm, where the rider education facilities including a state of the art Racewood Eventing Simulator and beautiful 90m x 60m polo turf arena are coupled with iconic Tasmanian scenery, clean open spaces and country hospitality. 

##Horse riding

This all inclusive package includes four days' riding and three nights’ accommodation, all meals and drinks, plus daily transfers from your accommodation to Junction Farm.

Your lessons will be on the famous Australian Horse Adventures trekking team, naturally educated for bitless barefoot riding, and they will focus on how to get the most out of these fabulous, spirited horses. Junction Farm Equestrian Park's, experienced and dedicated team of instructors will give you hours of instructed riding, trail, horsemanship and Racewood Eventing Simulator time to not only build you ability, confidence and joy in riding but set you up for even greater horse riding adventures ahead.

All this together with the renowned Australian Horse Adventures hospitality.

##The Nitty Gritty:

Ride Length: 4 days, 3 nights

Hours in the Saddle: 2 to 6

Pace: Depending on the Group

Riding Ability: Beginner to advanced. Advice on weight/height required prior to booking tour. Max weight 90 kilos.
Season: October, November, January

Group Size: Maximum 8.

Breed of Horse: Arabian, Arabian Cross, Waler Cross, Morgan Cross

Contact Us: Special group charter tours available on request.

Accommodation: Exclusive use of the beautiful and iconic heritage listed Fitzpatrick’s Inn with private rooms with en suite, lounge, bar, dining rooms and amazing gardens.

Food: The menu is based on showcasing the best regional Tasmania food and wine. All diets catered for, please advise at booking.

Transfer: Guests collected from Launceston Airport or City Centre and transferred to Junction Farm and accommodation in private minibuss

##Short Form Itenerary 
Day 1: Pick up, horse introduction, lessons, simulator practice, dinner at accommodation.

Day 2: Breakfast, training sessions, simulator time, snacks, lunch, dinner at accommodation.

Day 3: Specialist clinic, drinks, dinner with instructor.

Day 4: Trail ride at Junction Farm, afternoon tea, wrap-up, drop off in Launceston or at the airport.

##What to bring
- Suitable riding footwear 
- Flat soled riding boots & short chaps or long riding boots
- Comfortable riding pants 
- Riding tights or jodphurs are ideal, but or close fitting flexible pantsare fine.
- Long sleeved shirts
- Waterproof jacket
- Waterproof pants
- Casual clothing and footwear for evenings
- Gloves 
- Sunscreen
- Personal items including toiletries and medication
- A “fancy” outfit for dining out
- Riding Helmet

We aim to head out rain or shine so layering is ideal, wool mixes or thermal layers with a good jacket are recommended for the colder tours, lightweight layers for sun protection and staying cool are recommended for the warmer tours.

* Walk among a giant kauri tree and native forest

6. Return to Auckland CBD

474480.raw_desc:
description: # How the PADI Scuba Diver Course is completed in Coffs Harbour with Jetty Dive Centre!

## Duration
2 Days (+ self-study)

##About
The PADI Scuba Diver Course is PADI’s restricted entry level Scuba Diving Certification. This allows you to scuba dive anywhere in the world, under the supervision of an Instructor or Divemaster, to a depth of 12m.

##Inclusions
- Your PADI Scuba Diving Certification, registered in the PADI database, and digital certification card (E-Card)
- Two beautiful boat dives at the Solitary Islands Marine Park, aboard our world-class boats. No carting your heavy dive gear from the beach into the water!
- E-Learning in your personal PADI library that you can access for life!
- Confined water training in a pool prior to ocean diving
- Small group, 5-Star PADI training, for a more personal experience
- All equipment hire

**Open Water Ocean Dives are subject to weather and availability. Jetty Dive will contact you with any changes.**

By default, we book you in for 2 consecutive days when booking this course. If you would like to reschedule your 2nd day (your diving day) of your course, please contact us after booking and we will move your booking. 

##Requirements
- The ability to swim 200 metres or snorkel 300 metres (with mask, snorkel and fins).
- The ability to stay afloat or treat water for 10 minutes.
- You need to be healthy, and medically fit to scuba dive.
- You cannot Scuba Dive when pregnant.
474480.raw_booking:
We will issue your E-Learning Code as soon as we receive your booking, within our business hours. You will receive an email with a link to your E-Learning to get started on the PADI learning portal. You will also receive an email with **digital forms that must be completed prior to starting your course with us**. If you do not receive either of these emails, please check your junk/spam. If you still have not received these emails, please contact us.
The digital forms can also be accessed in your e-learning portal. See the screenshot below to demonstrate *where* in your e-learning portal. These are mandatory and **MUST** be completed before joining us for your course, no exceptions.
![Forms in E-Learning Portal](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/KmYCzR9QGK10A7aznZog)

By default, we book you in for 2 consecutive days when booking this course. If you would like to reschedule your 2nd day (your diving day) of your course, please contact us and we will move your booking. You will get confirmation emails for your day of diving. If you do not recieve one, please contact us. You will also receive an email with a waiver for your diving days. On a course, you do not need to fill in this diving waiver.

The Scuba Diver course involves three modules of theory. It takes approximately 3 hours to complete, please do not underestimate the theory and put it off.

The first day is your pool session day. For this you meet us at Jetty Dive Centre at 8am, learn equipment setup, and then we require you to meet us at the pool. Please ensure you have your own transport. Day 1 finishes at approximately 3:30-4pm. 
For your second day, please ensure you are at the dive shop at 7:30am. After setup at the shop, you will have to meet us down at the Marina. Please ensure you have your own transport.

Ensure you have everything you need:
- Some lunch for your pool session day (There is not much to buy at the pool)
- Any of your own gear you would like to use (we do provide all required equipment)
- Payment for the remainder of your course if you have not already paid in full.
- Seasickness tablets in you require them (we suggest them! Do not use ginger.)
- And swimmers, a towel, and reef-safe sunscreen.

If you have any other questions, let us know!

description: # Two Scuba Dives at the South Solitary Islands off of one of our dive boats.

## Duration
6 Hours

## About
You will be amazed the variety of Marine life! A mixture of fish from the tropics and sub-tropical varieties as well. At the Solitary Islands Marine Park the water is usually much cleaner and warmer because of the East Australian Current. The Solitary Islands Marine Park is in a sanctuary zone, and is teeming with life! Join us for a double-dive, and see what there is to see at the Solitary Islands Marine Park!

##Included
- Hire of your **second** dive tank is free of charge. If you do not own your own tank, you will have to select "Tank Hire"
- Snacks on board – hot water for cup-a-soup, tea, coffee, small serves of biscuits. We have vegetarian soups available. 
- The dives are guided by one of our team – unless you have specific circumstances that require a private Divemaster on that day (ie. You are certified to only 12m and we have no other customers restricted to 12m on that day.)
- Private Divemaster/tailored dives may incur additional charge. Contact Jetty Dive to discuss availability.

**Subject to weather and availability. Jetty Dive will contact you with any changes**

##Requirements
- You must provide proof of certification, this requires a PADI Scuba Diver Certification or equivalent or better.

-No Refunds for any trips cancelled within 48 hours, unless we can find a replacement for your booking.
474488.raw_booking:
Please ensure you are at Jetty Dive Centre at the appropriate time, **7:30am sharp**. After getting equipment sorted at the Dive Shop, we require you to drive down to the Marina and meet us at the wharf, so please ensure you have your own transport. We expect to return to the marina around 1:00pm-1:30pm

Before diving with us you must complete a waiver. This will come through in a separate email at the time of booking. If you do not receive this email please let us know. This waiver must be completed before joining us on our boats, no exceptions.

**If you are completing an Open Water Course or Advanced Course - you do not need to fill out this waiver!**

Ensure you have everything you need:
- Proof of certification (Image or digital card is fine)
- Any of your own gear you would like to use (we can provide equipment at additional rental cost)
- Payment for the remainder of your trip if you have not already paid in full.
- Seasickness tablets in you require them (we suggest them! The boat is constantly in motion, and we do not return to land in-between dives. Do not use ginger – it doesn’t work!)
- And swimmers, a towel, and reef-safe sunscreen. We have a Reef-Safe sunscreen only policy. Read more [here](https://jettydive.com.au/were-adopting-a-reef-safe-sunscreen-only-policy)

A light morning tea is provided on board:
- Hot water for cup-a-soup, tea, coffee

If you have any other questions, let us know!

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Join us for a 'one of a kind' weekly activity for homeschooled kids. Each week the kids program will be given challenges and instruction to build on the skills they've developed. Over time building up a solid technical surfing foundation week after week - something they'll have with them for life. Understandably different children will be at different levels, which is why we split the squad into groups to make sure everyone is comfortable and safe, as well as challenged throughout. Individualised coaching, in a group environment. The goal of the Homeschool Program is to arm your child with the technical skills to confidently surf green waves unassisted, trim across green waves and have the ocean skills to stay safe at all times in the surf. However our biggest goal - above all else - is to empower each child with the confidence to be in the waves, and more importantly instil the love of surfing into their lives.
If you've got your own gear - wetsuit, surfboard, etc, - that you'd like to use, that's totally fine, just be sure to bring it along with you.

483868.raw_desc:
#Experience the joy of shaping hot metal on a traditional Blacksmith’s anvil and under a power hammer.

##Duration 
Up To 4 Hours
Morning - 8:30am to 12:30pm
Afternoon - 1:30pm to 5:30pm

What you can expect from this HALF DAY Blacksmith Experience:

It's a PRIVATE experience so you will not be in with random people, it's just you and whoever you book with.

We provide all the equipment, materials and safety gear

You get to take home everything you make

You will get the chance to hand forge a variety of products and generally experience the joy of shaping hot metal on a traditional Blacksmith’s anvil and under a power hammer. You get to take home various products that you have made from scratch and they will be talking pieces for years to come.

Be prepared to get your hands dirty, with this very ‘hands on’ experience, forging metal objects from upcycled materials. I will be there assisting you, one-on-one, helping you understand the art of raw blacksmithing. 

No experience needed however it will definitely be helpful if you are comfortable using power tools, I will instruct you carefully and demonstrate the safe use of the tools and machinery, some of which you probably wouldn't have encountered before. 

The main tools and machines used are: 

A forge for heating the steel 

An anvil and hand hammer 

A power hammer

Angle grinders (cutting and surface grinding) 

A belt grinder, sometimes known as a linisher 

Wire wheel on a bench grinder

UPDATE JULY 1st 2025 - New Legislation around Swords

Due to unexpected new legislation in South Australia, it is now unfortunately illegal for us to offer sword-making, even during private workshops. The penalties for breaching this law are extremely harsh - up to 2 years in jail and a $20,000 fine - so while this is frustrating and disappointing, it’s simply not something we can risk.

Although there is no minimum age limit to participate in our Blacksmith Experiences, participants under the age of 18 may take part in knife-making activities only under the direct supervision of a parent or legal guardian.

If a participant under 18 creates a knife during a workshop, an adult must be present in order for the finished item to be taken home.
Without a supervising adult present, the knife will remain on-site and held for collection by a parent or guardian.

This policy ensures compliance with South Australian regulations and helps us maintain a safe and responsible workshop environment for all participants.

Please note :
If you wish to make a larger item like a Cleaver or Pizza Cutter or any wooden handled knives from our website you will need to book a FULL DAY experience due to the duration of the heat treatment. A maximum of 2 larger items can be made in one full day.

Hot Weather Policy

For the safety of our guests and staff, Bushy’s Projects does not operate blacksmithing experiences on days where the forecast temperature is above 32°C. Working with hot steel and an open forge in extreme heat creates unsafe conditions, so sessions will be postponed or rescheduled if this limit is exceeded.

If a day is forecast to reach over 32°C, we will contact all bookings as early as possible to arrange an alternative date or discuss available options. Your safety and comfort are always our top priority, and we appreciate your understanding in helping us maintain a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Aboriginal culture with our Cultural Tours. At Paperbark Arts & Exclusive Cultural Tours, we invite you to join us on an extraordinary journey that transcends time and takes you deep into the heart of Yarrabah, Far North Queensland. Whether you're a solo traveler, a family seeking cultural enrichment, or a group looking for a memorable adventure, our Cultural Tours promise an unforgettable experience that connects you with the heart and soul of Yarrabah's indigenous heritage.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
Expert Local Guides: Our knowledgeable Aboriginal guides share their ancestral wisdom and personal stories, offering profound insights into the land's history and significance.
Cultural Immersion: Immerse yourself in traditional ceremonies, rituals, and customs, gaining a profound understanding of Yarrabah's indigenous heritage.
Guided Walks: Explore sacred lands, lush forests, and pristine beaches on guided walks that reveal the hidden wonders of the region.
Cultural Performances: Witness captivating dance performances and storytelling sessions that bring ancient traditions to life.
Bush Tucker Experience: Savor the flavors of native Australian cuisine during a bush tucker tasting, connecting with the land through food.
Interactive Experiences: Participate in hands-on activities, such as traditional art and craft workshops, where you can create your own cultural artifacts.
Cultural Talks: Engage in conversations with local indigenous community members, deepening your knowledge of their history and culture.
Scenic Beauty: Marvel at the breathtaking landscapes of Far North Queensland, from coastal vistas to lush rainforests.
Cultural Exchange: Interact with the local Aboriginal community, forging meaningful connections and fostering mutual understanding.
Memorable Souvenirs: Have the opportunity to purchase authentic indigenous artwork and crafts, supporting local artisans.
Enriching Experience: Leave with a deeper appreciation for Aboriginal culture and a sense of connection to Yarrabah's heritage.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
• Acknowledgement of Country and Smoking Ceremony
• Guided bush walk with insights into bush medicine and native flora
• Traditional dance performance
• Hands-on arts and crafts workshop (painting, weaving, or crafting)
• Bush tucker tasting and lunch featuring native ingredients
• Visit to the local gallery, Yarrabah Museum, and historical landmarks
• Cultural storytelling and language introduction
• Souvenir from the cultural experience
• Small group sizes for an intimate experience
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
Essentials:
Respectful Attitude
Comfortable Clothing
Closed Footwear
Hat and Sunscreen
Water Bottle
Personal Items:
Camera or Smartphone
Optional Items:
Insect Repellent
Notebook and Pen

500249.raw_desc:
##Rates 4hrs $195 / 8hrs $320 +booking fee

#Poly Smartwave 

##About
1x full tank of fuel included. Tiller steer, Poly Smartwave, electric start, full shade canopy, life jackets, and all safety equipment included. 
The maximum carrying capacity is 450kg (which needs to cover all passengers & equipment including weight of eskies, ice and other personal belongings). 

##More info
On the day of your hire, simply come to the Bribie Beach Shack at your booked time. After a safety and local fishing brief, the boat will be launched for you from one of the many boat ramps. 
At the end of your hire period, simply return the boat to the beach area near the boat ramp at the Bribie Beach Shack where we will take care of it from there.

- The skipper of each boat hire must be at least 18 years of age.
- Similar to driving a bus, the designated skipper of the vessel for the day must remain at 0.0 Alcohol level, as is in charge of passengers
- As per Marine Safety regulations, children under 12 months (1 year old) are not recommended to travel on any of our boats.
- All children under 12 years of age must wear the lifejacket provided.
- No pets are allowed on any of our boats or watercraft as we are in a marine park.
- All boats are strict no-smoking and no-vaping vessels.
- Crab pots and cast nets are not permitted on this type of boat.
- Your booked hire time includes the time spent on the hire agreement process, hire area brief and boat brief. 

##What to bring
To make your booking with us you will need to bring with you on the day:
- a current Australian driver's licence (vehicle)
- boat licence details 
- credit card (or a bond of $500 in cash or on a debit card)

Bribie Beach Shack is a fully alcohol licensed bar, bait and tackle shop, cafe, take away and recreational boat hire business combined. You are welcome to bring your own gear, however, anything you may need will be available for hire or purchase prior to departure.
Please bring a sharp knife with you to take on the boat. This may be required to cut the anchor rope in the case of it getting stuck. Please also bring a bucket for your bait.

In the event of being overweight on the day and outside of the vessel's advertised weight limit, the vessel will not be allowed to depart, the hire will be cancelled and all monies forfeited.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
The PADI Open Water Diver Course is where the fun begins in learning to scuba dive and allows you to explore the underwater world for the first time. This course is the first level in diver certification and is your ticket to a world full of marine life few people get to experience. The Course has been designed to teach you the knowledge and skills necessary to dive independently with another certified diver to a maximum depth of 18 meters.
The DIVE EXPERIENCES team will contact you with any changes.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: All equipment is supplied to complete the course.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Theory: Complete your eLearning at home before Day 1. Day 1: Tuesday 09:00 am start for Confined water (pool) training on arrival first day. Day 2: Wednesday 07:30 depart for first two open water (ocean) dives return 3:00 pm. Day 3: Friday or Saturday 07:30 depart for the second two open water dives (ocean) and return at 3:00 pm.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: The minimum age to participate is 12 years old. You must be cleared as medically fit to dive by completing a Medical Statement prior to your course starting. If any questions are flagged as "Yes" you need to gain medical clearance from a doctor. Please ensure you complete - this Medical Statement before the start of your course. You must be able to swim 200 metres without stopping. There is no time limit for this and you may use any swimming stroke(s) you want. You must be able to float or tread water for 10 minutes, again using any method(s) you want.
field_values.redo_booking_departure_info: Please arrive 15 minutes prior

501965.raw_desc:
#The PADI Open Water Diver Course is where the fun begins in learning to scuba dive and allows you to explore the underwater world for the first time.

##Duration 
3 Days 

##About 
This course is the first level in diver certification and is your ticket to a world full of marine life few people get to experience.
The Course has been designed to teach you the knowledge and skills necessary to dive independently with another certified diver to a maximum depth of 18 meters. 

Please select your second diving day to be either Friday or Saturday and the DIVE Experiences team will contact you after a booking is made. 

This course requires all customers to pay for and complete the PADI E-Learning (approx 20 hours of online dive theory, valid for 12 months) that can be completed at home prior to starting the practical part of the course. 

Theory: Complete your eLearning at home before Day 1.
Day 1: Tuesday 09:00 am start for Confined water (pool) training on arrival first day
Day 2: Wednesday 07:30 depart for first two open water (ocean) dives return 3:00 pm
Day 3: Friday or Saturday 07:30 depart for the second two open water dives (ocean) and return at 3:00 pm

##Requirements:

- The minimum age to participate is 12 years old.
- You must be cleared as medically fit to dive by completing a Medical Statement prior to your course starting. If any questions are flagged as ""Yes"" you need to gain medical clearance from a doctor. Please ensure you complete - this Medical Statement before the start of your course.
- You must be able to swim 200 metres without stopping. There is no time limit for this and you may use any swimming stroke(s) you want.
- You must be able to float or tread water for 10 minutes, again using any method(s) you want.
- All equipment is supplied to complete the course
- Open Water Ocean Dives are subject to weather and availability. The DIVE EXPERIENCES team will contact you with any changes.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Australia’s original immersive, ‘trick-art’ experience has been reimagined! ArtVo Melbourne is proud to unveil its largest transformation since opening at The District in 2016. Featuring more than 40 brand new hand-painted interactive artworks, visitors are invited to embark on a global adventure through a series of immersive environments that transport guest across extraordinary destinations, iconic landmarks, diverse cultures, and larger-than-life adventures-all without leaving Melbourne. The extensive redevelopment features entirely new artworks created by a team of talented artists from Korea, renowned internationally for their expertise in immersive and illusion-based art experience. A completely refreshed self-guided gallery suitable for all ages, groups small or large with visitors capturing unforgettable photos with family and friends, while creating memories that will last a lifetime. Just take a look at the ArtVo Instagram page @artvo_melbourne, not short of inspiration for your next visit. ArtVo offers everyone the chance to experience the traditional art museum in a whole new way. It offers their patrons the opportunity, to not only touch the art but be the art by simply striking a pose in front of the camera. What is even more refreshing are the museum staff who encourage you to take as many photos and selfies as possible. They can assist you so you and your friends are free to become part of the art at all times.
what_is_included: **WHAT DO I GET WITH MY TICKET?**
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: The standard visit includes a quick introduction to the patrons before they head into the gallery explaining the concept of the artwork and how the photos are taken. Afterwards they are free to head into the gallery and go through at their own pace with staff in the gallery to assist. Most of the visit is self-guided other than the initial introduction. The experience generally takes around 1 hour.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Patrons need to bring their own smartphones and cameras to take photos
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Yes

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Explore Tropical North Queensland’s natural treasures with us.
Pressed for time???
Join our Cairns Explorer Tour where the reef meets the rain forest, and immerse yourself in the stunning contrasts of the beautiful ancient World Heritage rainforest.
Escape the ordinary and immerse yourself in the lush beauty of Tropical North Queensland on this flexible half-day adventure. Designed for nature lovers and thrill-seekers alike, this tour combines rainforest walks, crystal-clear swimming holes, and iconic sights—all packed into one unforgettable experience.
Your journey begins with a guided walk through the Cairns Botanic Gardens, where you’ll uncover the fascinating story of the region’s ancient rainforest and its unique evolution. Relax and take in breathtaking views as you travel along scenic tropical roads surrounded by stunning landscapes.
Pause at the secluded Crystal Cascades, a peaceful rainforest gem, before heading to Behana Gorge, where you’ll take a refreshing dip beneath the spectacular Clamshell Falls. Along the way, enjoy sweeping views and the famous photo opt of Walsh’s Pyramid and catch a glimpse of the historic Gordonvale Sugar Mill.
With multiple opportunities to swim, explore, and unwind, every tour is tailored by your expert guide to match the day’s conditions and your group’s vibe—ensuring a safe, personalized, and unforgettable Cairns adventure.

Time to enjoy your breakfast before adventuring

Gordonvale Sugar Mill (QLDs Cane Toad ground zero)
Crystal Cascades
Cairns Botanic Gardens
* Please note, while we aim to visit these best locations each day, access may vary due to conditions and logistical factors.

Wear weather-appropriate, comfortable clothes suitable for a day of sightseeing.
Choose sturdy and comfortable walking shoes, especially if you plan to explore the areas around the waterfalls.
Bring sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses to shield yourself from the tropical sun.
Stay hydrated during the tour by carrying a reusable water bottle.
Capture the breathtaking scenery with a camera or smartphone for lasting memories.
Pack some light snacks to keep your energy up throughout the day, as lunch is not provided.
Given Cairns' tropical climate, consider packing a light rain jacket or poncho just in case.
Carry your belongings conveniently in a small backpack or daypack.
If there's an opportunity to take a dip in the waterfalls, bring swimwear and a towel.
Protect yourself from potential insects in outdoor areas.
Have some cash or cards for any personal expenses or optional activities.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Frequently referred to as one of New Zealand's most spectacular destinations, Omanawa Falls is situated in the stunning Kaimai ranges. At its heart featuring a breathtaking 35m waterfall cascading into a pristine pool surrounded by lush New Zealand native rainforest. Kaitiaki Adventures will lead you on an unparalleled, culturally integral, and historic guided walk that immerses you in the rich cultural history of the Ngati Hangarau people. A regenerative tourism experience in the unique cultural space of Omanawa Falls.
Immerse yourself in the surrounding flora and fauna while listening to the stories of the area, the Awa (River), and the cultural values of mana whenua.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Join our friendly, knowledgeable local guides through the beautiful trails to 2 lookouts, the Māori carvings, the century old hydro electric power station service tunnel and the breathtaking Omanawa falls. Departing Omanawa falls follows a visit to McLaren Falls and Tauranga's best view point the Minden Lookout.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Departing Sydney at 0600 and only 90 minutes from Sydney, the Central coast has some beautiful habitats and bird species not found so easily in Sydney. Ourimbah Rest Stop is a great place to start. We look for Bassian Thrush, Regent Bowerbird, Green Catbird, Yellow-throated Scrubwren and other rainforest species. We then head off to Central Coast Wetlands (Pioneer Dairy) where over 230 species have been recorded, including a variety of waterbirds and Red-rumped Parrots. Tuggerah Wetlands is close by and has a variety of waterbirds as is McPherson Road Swamp, where we may see the giant Black-necked Stork. Palmdale is an exciting stop for Australian Logrunner, Noisy Pitta, Rose Robin and White-headed Pigeon. Final stop is St Huberts Island to locate the elusive Bush Stone-curlew. Expect to identify 80+ species. Arrive back in Sydney around 1800.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: professional bird guide, transport, water, snacks, binos, scope, bird book and apps

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Welcome to our Beginner Drone Photography Workshop, a comprehensive course designed specifically for those interested in exploring the exciting world of aerial photography. This workshop is perfect for those who have recently purchased their first drone or who are looking to upgrade their photography skills to include aerial perspectives.
The course starts with introducing the fundamentals of drone operation and safety guidelines to ensure you fly responsibly and within legal boundaries. We then delve into the technicalities of drone photography, such as understanding and adjusting drone camera settings, mastering flight modes, and learning about various drone models and their capabilities.
Our workshop further explores the creative aspects of drone photography. You will learn about composition techniques from an aerial perspective, such as leading lines, patterns, and symmetry. We will also cover different lighting conditions, teaching you how to work with natural light and use it to your advantage to create stunning aerial shots.
Throughout the course, you will have hands-on practice sessions under the supervision of our experienced instructors. These sessions will provide you with real-world experience, helping you apply what you have learned, refine your skills, and build confidence in drone operation and aerial photography. Whether you are an aspiring photographer looking to master the art of drone photography or a hobbyist looking to capture breathtaking aerial views, our workshop provides the necessary knowledge, skills, and inspiration.

field_values.redo_desc_about: This 2-day workshop focuses on building knowledge about hot glass and introducing the fundamental skills of glassblowing. You will take the first steps on your glass journey. Expect to learn and sweat a lot! Starting with gathering molten glass out of the furnace, on the first day you will learn how to shape the hot glass using the marver and tools, and add colour to your glass. The second day begins with you blowing a bubble into the molten glass to make a clear ornament and we finish the day making your own clear and coloured tumblers. By the end of the weekend, each student will have five pieces of their own; 2 paperweights, 2 tumblers, and a small blown ornament.

description: 2 days • 12 hours total

• Saturday, 12pm - 6pm
• Sunday, 10am - 4pm

This 2-day workshop focuses on building knowledge about hot glass and introducing the fundamental skills of glassblowing. 

You will take the first steps on your glass journey. Expect to learn and sweat a lot!

Starting with gathering molten glass out of the furnace, on the first day you will learn how to shape the hot glass using the marver and tools, and add colour to your glass. The second day begins with you blowing a bubble into the molten glass to make a clear ornament and we finish the day making your own clear and coloured tumblers.

By the end of the weekend, each student will have five pieces of their own; 2 paperweights, 2 tumblers, and a small blown ornament.

Class size is limited to 4 people so that everyone gets individual attention and enough time to work with the glass. We must have at least 3 people to run this workshop.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
The Supper Club at Hapuku Kitchen offers a unique dining experience in our home, inspired by nature's larder. Join us for dinner celebrating foraged and sustainably farmed produce from the wild environment of Kaikōura, New Zealand, prepared and cooked in our kitchen at the base of the world. Our three-course, set menus are a celebration of the season and everything the region has to offer. Our dining table seats twelve guests and while you're savouring the flavours of Kaikōura, you'll hear stories about how we grow our food, how we forage from the mountains to the sea and the people behind locally sourced ingredients. We focus on ingredients we have grown ourselves, foraged or sourced from our neighbours. Everything is made from scratch and the menu is finalised the day prior, based on what is at its absolute best. Get a group of friends or family together and book the entire table of twelve, or book a seat and meet other people interested in good food and great company.
Supper clubs are places for people to enjoy fine, high-quality food, without formalities.
Many supper clubs are hosted by people in their own houses, so it feels as though you're visiting them for dinner.
A supper club really can be anything, with many taking the form of pop-up concepts and even underground restaurants.
Typically there is no choice when it comes to the menu, and the whole thing has a more relaxed, communal feeling when compared to a restaurant.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: We are licensed premises and offer a small list of carefully selected wines from Canterbury and Marlborough as well as local beer, gin and our own home-made non-alcoholic sodas.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: When making your booking, please inform our team about any food allergies. We are able to accommodate any dietary requirements with 48 hours notice.
field_values.redo_booking_departure_info: We encourage you to arrive by 7pm (arrival anytime from 6.45 pm) when you'll be welcomed in to our home and have the chance to relax before dinner.
field_values.redo_booking_important_info: If you haven't already, please inform our team about any food allergies. We are able to accommodate any dietary requirements with 48 hours notice.

description: #The Supper Club at Hapuku Kitchen offers a unique dining experience in our home, inspired by nature's larder

##Duration
3 Hours

##About
Join us for dinner celebrating foraged and sustainably farmed produce from the wild environment of Kaikōura, New Zealand, prepared and cooked in our kitchen at the base of the world.

Our three-course, set menus are a celebration of the season and everything the region has to offer.

Our dining table seats twelve guests and while you're savouring the flavours of Kaikōura, you'll hear stories about how we grow our food, how we forage from the mountains to the sea and the people behind locally sourced ingredients.

We focus on ingredients we have grown ourselves, foraged or sourced from our neighbours. Everything is made from scratch and the menu is finalised the day prior, based on what is at its absolute best.

Get a group of friends or family together and book the entire table of twelve, or book a seat and meet other people interested in good food and great company.

###What is a Supper Club? 
It's a good question. Supper clubs are places for people to enjoy fine, high-quality food, without formalities. Many supper clubs are hosted by people in their own houses, so it feels as though you're visiting them for dinner.

A supper club really can be anything, with many taking the form of pop-up concepts and even underground restaurants. Typically there is no choice when it comes to the menu, and the whole thing has a more relaxed, communal feeling when compared to a restaurant.

###Drinks?
We are licensed premises and offer a small list of carefully selected wines from Canterbury and Marlborough as well as local beer, gin and our own home-made non-alcoholic sodas.

###Dietary Restrictions and Allergies
When making your booking, please inform our team about any food allergies. We are able to accommodate any dietary requirements with 48 hours notice.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Explore Oneke, a special area home to unique culture, beautiful coastal landscapes and wild kiwi.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights: Exclusive access: Explore Oneke, a heritage-rich and rarely visited area, ensuring a unique and immersive experience.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: Sea cruise: Scenic boat transfer to Oneke, a remote area only accessible by water. Cultural welcome and Whare visit: Time in the Oneke whare (Māori meeting house) with storytelling, formal acknowledgement of the land, and cultural traditions. Kiwi presentation: Learn about brown kiwi behaviour, conservation, and ongoing protection efforts. Kiwi experience: Guided evening walk through native bush and along the coastline with the opportunity to see Stewart Island Brown kiwi in their natural habitat. Wildlife encounters: Discover Ruru (morepork), sea lions, and other coastal species. Conservation: Witness pest eradication and ongoing restoration efforts by Rakiura Māori.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: This experience is suitable for ages 15+. A reasonable level of fitness is required (walking approximately 2 hours through coastal forest and along beach tracks).
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: However, kiwis are wild and unpredictable, and there is no 100% guarantee they will appear. Their rareness and the thrill of searching are what makes the experience special and enjoyable, so we cannot offer refunds if there is no sighting. Instead, $20 per person will be donated to conservation projects at Little Glory Cove, so we can continue to increase the chances of seeing the incredible tokoeka in the wild.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Please note that due to the late departure times, you will need to arrange accommodation on Stewart Island for the evening.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Slither on in to the Discover Deadly Reptile Education Centre. Whether you have a fascination or fear of scaley critters this renowned reptile centre provides “edutainment” at its finest. Enjoy a fun experience with a difference: meet a friendly python, watch dragons being fed, learn about arachnids, listen to the frog chorus, or simply be mesmerised by the floating turtles. Grab a barista-made coffee while exploring the garden where there is a themed nature play including a life-size 3D snakes and ladders game. The centre holds over 40 different species of reptiles, amphibians, arachnids, and birds including a rather spectacular crocodile. Discover Deadly promotes conservation and respect for all native wildlife, it truly is one of Western Australia’s best reptile centres. Learn deadly cool facts about some of the world's most misunderstood critters, and watch how they feed. Two large backdrops provide the perfect place to capture a unique photograph with a python and take a memorable moment home.

field_values.redo_desc_about: An informative cruise along the magnificent Lord Howe Island coastline. Experience the wild beauty of Lord Howe Island on an unforgettable adventure cruise exploring dramatic sea cliffs, remote offshore islands and pristine waters filled with marine life. Home to the world’s southernmost coral reef, the island also supports unique endemic marine species, migratory seabirds, and spectacular coastal scenery. Travel aboard Reef N Beyond as you journey to the stunning Admiralty Islands, with expert commentary from the crew on the island’s fascinating geology, wildlife, and renowned sea birds along the way. This tour offers incredible opportunities for sightseeing, wildlife encounters, and experiencing the remote beauty of Lord Howe from the water.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights: Tall sea cliffs, abundant marine life, that often includes turtles, dolphins, flying fish & large schools of fish. Select the snorkel option if offered for a fish eye view!
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: Please note: Tours are weather and passenger-number dependent and may be rescheduled to ensure the best possible experience. We recommend booking early in your stay.

description: **An informative cruise along the magnificent Lord Howe Island coastline.** 

Experience the wild beauty of Lord Howe Island on an unforgettable adventure cruise exploring dramatic sea cliffs, remote offshore islands and pristine waters filled with marine life. Home to the world’s southernmost coral reef, the island also supports unique endemic marine species, migratory seabirds, and spectacular coastal scenery.

Travel aboard Reef N Beyond as you journey to the stunning Admiralty Islands, with expert commentary from the crew on the island’s fascinating geology, wildlife, and renowned sea birds along the way.
This tour offers incredible opportunities for sightseeing, wildlife encounters, and experiencing the remote beauty of Lord Howe from the water.

Please note: Tours are weather and passenger-number dependent and may be rescheduled to ensure the best possible experience. We recommend booking early in your stay.
highlights: Tall sea cliffs, abundant marine life, that often includes turtles, dolphins, flying fish & large schools of fish. Select the snorkel option if offered for a fish eye view!

Noosaville Library, accessible via Wallace Drive at Noosa Leisure Centre.
- Land Species: Kangaroos, koalas echidnas, possums, and various bird species like glossy black cockatoos and white-bellied sea eagles.
- Marine Life: Explore coastal areas where you might spot reef fish, bottlenose dolphins, and loggerhead turtles.

Noosa North Shore Wilderness Trail: Traverse this serene trail, surrounded by the rich biodiversity of the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. The area is home to over 700 native wildlife species including kangaroos, echidnas, and various bird species.

553713.raw_desc:
meeting_point: Noosaville Library, Noosa Qld
description: ###Starting Point:
Noosaville Library, accessible via Wallace Drive at Noosa Leisure Centre. Bus Stop ID: 302129

###Age Requirement:
Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Adult-sized e-bikes are charged at full price. Child options are available.

##Key Information 
Please arrive by 9:40 AM for a mandatory 20-minute safety briefing. The tour starts promptly at 10:00 AM and takes around two hours.

##Tour Overview:
Embark on a scenic e-bike tour to explore the Noosa North Shore Wilderness Trail. This journey includes a picturesque ferry crossing and rides through iconic local landmarks. 

The tour highlights include:
- Gympie Terrace: Enjoy a ride along the vibrant Noosa River, offering serene views and a lively atmosphere perfect for outdoor enthusiasts. Experience the local culture with various dining options and outdoor activities.
- Noosa Marina and Council Buildings: Glide past these key landmarks as you make your way to the historical Moorindil Street Ferry.
- Moorindil Street Ferry: Board the ferry that connects the mainland to Noosa North Shore. This ferry has been a lifeline for the area, evolving from a modest barge to a robust dual-ferry operation crucial for accessing the local natural attractions.
- Noosa North Shore Wilderness Trail: Traverse this serene trail, surrounded by the rich biodiversity of the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. The area is home to over 700 native wildlife species including kangaroos, echidnas, and various bird species.

Wildlife and Natural Beauty:
The Noosa North Shore is part of a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, teeming with native fauna. Keep an eye out for:
- Land Species: Kangaroos, koalas echidnas, possums, and various bird species like glossy black cockatoos and white-bellied sea eagles.
- Marine Life: Explore coastal areas where you might spot reef fish, bottlenose dolphins, and loggerhead turtles. 
- Noosa National Park: A short distance from Hastings Street, this park is a great spot to see koalas, wallabies, and more.
##Return Trip:
The tour concludes with a return ride along the same picturesque route, giving you another chance to soak in the stunning river views and lush landscapes.
553713.raw_booking:
###Discover Noosa North Shore e-Bike Tour – Important Confirmation Notes

- Weather & Wet Months: This tour explores the stunning Noosa North Shore and will proceed in light showers, adding to the adventure. However, during the wettest months (January to March) or in cases of heavy rainfall, tours may be postponed for safety. Please [check the forecast](https://weather.com/weather/tenday/l/1c5384a666a162b17e6e7d4031d27e5456441a5112a67fe2ea2f9f9b0cc19db8) and come prepared.
- Sun Safety: Expect open trails with sun exposure—wear sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses, and light, breathable clothing for protection.
- Stay Hydrated: Bring a water bottle to keep refreshed throughout the ride.
- Child Options: If you're bringing children and need personalised options, please call 0473 635 865 before your tour.

Get ready for an unforgettable ride through Noosa’s breathtaking coastal landscapes! 🚴‍♂️🌿🏖️

field_values.redo_desc_about: Enjoy a taster of the scenery Fiordland is so famous for with a short adventure into the remote and untamed Kepler Mountains – the maunga traversed by the Kepler Great Walk trail. Departing from our Te Anau lakeside base, the journey begins by soaring over Lake Te Anau and high over the Kepler Great Walk trail. Soak up views of the Hidden Lakes before flying above the local’s playground that is the lower Kepler Mountains. We land at a mountain tarn – take a breath of crisp alpine air and enjoy rugged mountain views out over the Main Divide. The perfect Fiordland scenic flight ‘sampler’ and a great way to get a feel for the enormity, grandeur and mauri of Fiordland’s landscapes.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
Soar high above the Kepler Mountains and view the Kepler Track from the air
Land beside a pretty mountain tarn with views of the Main Divide
Enjoy viewing the ‘Hidden Lakes’ from the air
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
Sunglasses
Closed/covered shoes
Warm clothing - it's usually cooler on the mountain tops so wear a couple of layers
Camera for those Instagram worthy shots but please no drones or selfie sticks
A big smile!

Departing from our Te Anau lakeside base, the journey begins by soaring over Lake Te Anau and high over the Kepler Great Walk trail. Soak up views of the Hidden Lakes before flying above the local’s playground that is the lower Kepler Mountains.

We land at a mountain tarn – take a breath of crisp alpine air and enjoy rugged mountain views out over the Main Divide.

The perfect Fiordland scenic flight ‘sampler’ and a great way to get a feel for the enormity, grandeur and mauri of Fiordland’s landscapes.

- Soar high above the Kepler Mountains and view the Kepler Track from the air
- Land beside a pretty mountain tarn with views of the Main Divide
- Enjoy viewing the ‘Hidden Lakes’ from the air

##What Should You Bring 
• Sunglasses 
• Closed/covered shoes 
• Warm clothing - it's usually cooler on the mountain tops so wear a couple of layers 
• Camera for those Instagram worthy shots but please no drones or selfie sticks 
• A big smile! 

##Weather Updates & Travel Information 
The weather we experience in Fiordland National Park can change quickly, therefore if flying conditions are not suitable, we may have to reschedule or cancel your flight. We will check weather conditions the day before your flight and contact you if we have any concerns. Rest assured that tours booked directly with us are fully refundable if there is a cancellation due to the weather.

##More info
• All prices listed are Share with Others. If you would prefer to book an exclusive private flight, please let us know at the time of booking and we will confirm the cost with you.
• Please note that all flights are subject to change and weather conditions. We reserve the right to cancel, reschedule, or refund your booking if the minimum number of participants is not met. We require a minimum of 2 passenger fares for Te Anau flights

field_values.redo_desc_about: Yandama On Country welcomes you for a gentle, immersive Aboriginal cultural tour around the picturesque Jiguma Track situated on Thaua Country in Pambula Beach New South Wales. Join your local Indigenous tour guide Nathan Lygon to gain an understanding about the rich cultural history of the local and surrounding areas. Your experience begins with an intimate smoking ceremony welcoming you onto Country. As you are then guided through Country, hear stories relating to plants, animals and the connection Aboriginal people have with the land. Learn about local ecologies, traditional foods and medicines, Cultural land management and more. After your walk, indulge in a spread of quality Indigenous inspired refreshments followed by an interactive Aboriginal artefact display, talk and touch. This is an excellent tour option for those wanting to slow down, relax, feel grounded and connect with nature.

- Experience ends and you will be shuttled you back to lifesaving club carpark

field_values.redo_desc_about: You will be transferred to Rere Rockslide, where you can slide down a 60m natural slope (free of charge but you need something to slide on and will do so at your own risk, or you can just watch others). Once you’ve had your adrenaline fix, you can head off on your bike for a more relaxed visit to the spectacular Rere Falls. A great spot where you can enjoy a picnic lunch. After lunch, embark on a 14 km hilly ride to Eastwoodhill Arboretum. If time allows, stop and enjoy a walk around the magnificent gardens. When you are ready, get on your bike, and prepare for a change of pace as you head down Ngatapa Hill, an exhilarating downhill ride. Wind your way back to Gisborne through the productive Poverty Bay Flats, home to quality vineyards and wineries. Make your way to the Sunshine Brewery, Tairāwhiti Gisborne’s iconic craft brew house. This tour offers intermediate riding and you will travel +/- 50 kilometers.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Join us for a full day of indulgence, discovery, and scenic beauty on our Hunter Valley Day Tour.
Settle into our comfortable air-conditioned coach, relax, and enjoy the picturesque drive north.
This tour brings together wine, food, scenery, and indulgence - promising a memorable day you’ll want to share and savour.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
Premium wine tastings at iconic Hunter Valley wineries
A curated two-course lunch paired with local wines
Heavenly chocolate tasting experience
Visit to a local cheese factory to shop for soft cheeses and other styles to take home, that pair beautifully with the wines you have tried today
Return transport in a modern, air-conditioned coach

Your adventure begins with a 7:00am departure from Central Station, Bay 8 (Western Concourse), followed by a quick pickup at the Furama Hotel Darling Harbour.

Discover one of the region’s most historic and celebrated winemakers, where generations of craftsmanship meet modern excellence.

3:00pm - Local Cheese Factory

field_values.redo_desc_about: Explore the Whitsunday Coast from Cedar Creek Falls in the hinterland to remote beaches, stopping for lunch on our Coastal Explorer Bus Tour. Great value all-inclusive tour! Go further and see more on the Coastal Explorer. Great value all-inclusive tour! 1. Explore the Whitsunday Coast hinterland with a visit to Cedar Creek Falls and rockpool. Swim in the fresh waterhole, explore the creek up- and downstream from the falls. The hike to the top of the falls is not for the faint hearted, but is worth the climb for the adventurous. After rain the waterfall will be flowing (seasonal). Listen to the sounds of the Australian bush with birds and butterflies making a flash appearance. Look for freshwater turtles. 2. On to Whitsunday Gold Coffee Farm for a quick rest stop where you may want to buy a coffee and morning tea snack. Check out the colourful native Australian birds and resident animals: Crispy & Crackle the pigs, the chickens and doves, goats, alpacas, and guinea pigs. 3. We will head towards the Hydeaway Bay region through cane farms and cattle properties, reaching a secret beach known locally as 'Frog Rock'. You can dip your toes in the crystal-clear water, take a leisurely stroll along the beach, explore the large boulders, and spot living creatures in the rock pools. 4. Upon arrival at the Cape Gloucester Resort, a delicious lunch and drink will be served, wit the option to purchase further drinks or cocktails at your leisure. Dine on the deck overlooking the beachfront getaway. Then you can relax, enjoy a swim in the pool, or a stroll along the beachfront.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: Tour includes hotel transfers from Jubilee Pocket to Cannonvale, tour guide and commentary in our new, fully air-conditioned touring coach, lunch + beverage and full use of resort facilities.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Not recommend for children under 3 and we can not fit car seats in the bus.

##About
Go further and see more on the Coastal Explorer. Great value all-inclusive tour!

1. Explore the Whitsunday Coast hinterland with a visit to Cedar Creek Falls and rockpool. Swim in the fresh waterhole, explore the creek up- and downstream from the falls. The hike to the top of the falls is not for the faint hearted, but is worth the climb for the adventurous. After rain the waterfall will be flowing (seasonal). Listen to the sounds of the Australian bush with birds and butterflies making a flash appearance. Look for freshwater turtles. 

2. On to Whitsunday Gold Coffee Farm for a quick rest stop where you may want to buy a coffee and morning tea snack. Check out the colourful native Australian birds and resident animals: Crispy & Crackle the pigs, the chickens and doves, goats, alpacas, and guinea pigs. 

3. We will head towards the Hydeaway Bay region through cane farms and cattle properties, reaching a secret beach known locally as 'Frog Rock'. You can dip your toes in the crystal-clear water, take a leisurely stroll along the beach, explore the large boulders, and spot living creatures in the rock pools. 

4. Upon arrival at the Cape Gloucester Resort, a delicious lunch and drink will be served, wit the option to purchase further drinks or cocktails at your leisure. Dine on the deck overlooking the beachfront getaway. Then you can relax, enjoy a swim in the pool, or a stroll along the beachfront. 

Tour includes hotel transfers from Jubilee Pocket to Cannonvale, tour guide and commentary in our new, fully air-conditioned touring coach, lunch + beverage and full use of resort facilities.

- Booking voucher

field_values.redo_desc_about: Dive into the ultimate Whitsundays adventure, where every trip is tailored for unforgettable catches and endless smiles! Whether you're an experienced angler or a complete beginner, our extensive knowledge of the best fishing spots and easy-going, personable nature make this charter a top choice for anyone looking to reel in a great catch. With years of experience navigating the Whitsundays, we ensure that each trip is tailored to meet the needs of every guest. Our friendly demeanour and engaging conversation make for a fun and informative day on the water, while our deep understanding of local marine life guarantees that you'll be fishing in the best possible locations. Whether you're looking to catch barramundi, coral trout, or other prized species, our expertise will guide you every step of the way. From seasoned fishers looking to challenge themselves to families and beginners eager to learn the ropes, Get Out & About Whitsundays Fishing & Tours provides an inclusive and enjoyable experience for all. The charter is well-equipped, and we are committed to ensuring that everyone has a safe, successful, and memorable day on the water. Join us for a fishing charter that combines adventure, relaxation, and a true taste of the Whitsundays' marine wonders. Whether you're after the thrill of the catch or a peaceful day surrounded by stunning seascapes, this tour delivers on all fronts.

The 2 day program runs consecutively from the date you book. NRMA SurfGroms adopts an approach to learning that uses group-based games to not only equip your child with the skills they need to surf and/or SUP, but also to encourage their participation by having fun. Every Woolworths SurfGroms lesson is designed purposefully to create a positive and supportive learning environment. NRMA SurfGroms teaches children from 5-12 years old core skills in the ocean across five incremental skill levels, as well as fundamental Ocean Awareness and Beach Safety skills such as surf survival and rescue techniques; basic first aid skills; and about varying surf conditions at the beach.
We even have a class next weekend for the school holidays – starting 4th October weekend!

Beach Basics: We kick things off on the sand with simple technique tips, fun warm-ups, and the must-know ocean safety stuff so everyone feels confident before heading out.
Surf Time!: Then it’s into the water for heaps of wave time in safe, waist-to-chest-deep conditions. Expect a mix of surfing, surf-themed beach games, ocean awareness, skills drills, and logbook activities spread throughout the program.
Coaching & Support: Our team is right there with you — helping you catch waves, giving you clear, friendly pointers, keeping things safe, and making sure the froth levels stay high.
Wrap-Up: About 15–20 minutes before finishing, we’ll head back to the beach for a quick chat about how you went and what you’ll work on next time.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Riding a trick skateboard is an exhilarating experience that combines balance, agility, and creativity. Designed specifically for performing tricks, these skateboards feature smaller, harder wheels and narrower decks compared to cruisers or longboards. These characteristics make trick skateboards ideal for technical manoeuvres like ollies, flips, grinds, and aerial tricks, especially in skate parks and urban environments.
The first step in mastering a trick skateboard is building a solid foundation in balance and control. Learning how to properly stand on the deck, control your speed, and steer using your body weight are essential skills. Once comfortable, riders can begin practising basic tricks like the ollie, which is the foundation of many more advanced tricks. An ollie allows skaters to lift the board off the ground without using their hands and is crucial for jumps and aerial stunts.
As riders progress, they can experiment with more advanced tricks like kickflips, where the skateboard rotates underfoot while airborne, or grinding on rails and ledges. Each trick requires precise foot placement and timing, demanding hours of practice to perfect. Skating on smooth surfaces like concrete in skate parks or streets is ideal for these types of tricks, as hard wheels give better speed and control on such surfaces.
In addition to technique, riding a trick skateboard also emphasises creativity and personal style. Skaters often combine tricks, develop their own variations, and find unique spots in urban landscapes to showcase their skills. The individuality of skating is a big part of its appeal, making it more than just a sport, but a form of self-expression.
Overall, riding a trick skateboard requires patience, practice, and persistence, but the rewards are immense. It’s a challenging, dynamic sport that continually pushes your limits, offering an ever-evolving sense of accomplishment and fun.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Embark on an immersive journey through the stunning landscapes of the Hauraki Coromandel Peninsula, where natural beauty meets Māori cultural heritage. Starting with a pick-up from the Matariki Tours Hub at 150 Pound Street, Coromandel, guests will set off on a scenic round-trip along the western coast of the peninsula to Colville, where they can relax and enjoy morning tea at the charming Pickled Hereford Café.
The adventure continues as we cross the majestic Coromandel Ranges, offering breathtaking views of Moehau (Tūpuna Maunga) while traveling through Waikawau Bay, Little Bay, and Tuateawa on the peninsula’s eastern side. Upon arrival at Tokatea Maunga, guests will be treated to a presentation overlooking the stunning Hauraki Gulf. Here, a knowledgeable kaikorero (speaker) will guide them through the history and significance of the surrounding landscape and the cultural landmarks, providing a deep insight into the Māori worldview and local traditions.
During this experience, guests will participate in workshops that bring ancient Māori customs to life, gaining hands-on insights into practices such as Rongoā Māori (traditional healing). Through captivating storytelling, the kaikorero will reveal the significance of Matariki (the Māori New Year) and share the profound connection Māori culture holds with "Papatūānuku" (Mother Earth), "Ranginui" (Father Sky), and "Tikapa Moana" (the ancestral ocean).
Afterward, guests will be transported back to Coromandel Town, where they can explore local shops and enjoy the vibrant hospitality scene. This tour offers an ideal blend of adventure, cultural enrichment, and the chance to experience the charm of Coromandel’s community firsthand.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
- View Hauraki Maori ancestral Mountain "Te Moenga Hau O Tamatekapua"
- Amazing look at ancient Maori rock fish traps
- Marae visit
- Experience a Maori Warrior welcoming delegation "Kaiwero"
- Try our world-famous Hangi for Lunch.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Expert Maori guide with in-depth knowledge of local traditions
- Round-trip transportation from pick up point
- Visits to significant cultural and historical landmarks on the Hauraki Coromandel Peninsular.
- Small group setting for a personalised experience.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded:
- Accommodation
- Travel insurance
- Meals and snacks outside included lunch
- Transportation to and from the tours initial pick up point
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
1. Arrival: Check in, Karakia,
2. Departure: H&S briefing, Tour, Short break
3. Mt Tokatea Wero, Pōwhiri, Kaikorero, Presentation
4. Return trip to Coromandel Town
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Weather appropriate clothing (layered clothing, rain jacket, hat)
- Sunscreen and Sunglasses
- Water bottle
- Personal medication, if needed
- Camera or Smartphone for photos
- Small day pack for personal items
- Cash or Card for potential purchases (souvenirs, snacks)
- Binoculars (optional)
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: Full refund with 24 hours notice or in the case of extreme weather.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Please arrive 15 minutes early, we depart promptly at the scheduled time. You'll receive a QR code with your confirmation email that we will scan to check you in, so bring your phone!
field_values.redo_meeting_point: 150 Pound Street, Coromandel, 3506, Aotearoa New Zealand Look for the Matariki Tours Mini Bus, Please arrive 10min early

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Get ready for family fun on the track! Our **Rimo Evo6 - 6.5 HP Junior Karts** are perfect for young speedsters over 130cm tall to drive their very own kart, while our **Double Karts** let kids over 3 years old but under 130cm join the excitement with an adult (18+). And don’t worry—**adults can get behind the wheel too**, making it a race the whole family can enjoy together! It’s the ultimate way for your whole family to race together, making it a thrilling experience for kids and adults alike. Whether it’s your first lap or your fastest, everyone can share in the excitement of the track. **Book now and make it a family race day to remember!**
- Ways to have the track to yourself include: having 8 people (a full track) in your group or paying for a full track of 8 people even if you have less participants.
- We have a 0 alcohol and drug tolerance policy, participants under the influence will not be allowed to race, and race ticket will not be refunded.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- **Safety Briefing & Helmet Fitting:** Prepare for the track with our safety video, expert tips from our track marshals, and all the essential gear to race confidently and securely.
- **Timed Racing Experience:** Race against the clock for your fastest lap time.
- **Club Speed Lap Results:** Take home a detailed time sheet to see how you stacked up against the competition.
- **"Viewpoint" Video:** Relive your racing with an exciting take-home video.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded:
- **Balaclava Requirement:** A balaclava must be purchased unless you already own one.
- **Personal Helmets:** You’re welcome to bring your own helmet, provided it complies with Australian Safety Standards.

- Closed toe shoes.
- Balaclava (available for purchase)
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: All drivers must be taller then 130cm to drive their own kart. All double kart passengers must be 3 years old + (not suitable for adult passengers). All double kart drivers must be 18 years old +.

faqs: Can Adults Race in the Junior/Family Karts?
- Yes, whilst these karts are slightly restricted in speed for young children they are still suitable to fit adult drivers. We welcome families to drive together on the track. 

How Many People Can Race? 
- 8 people max on track at once, if more in your group we can book more track times. 

Can I Have The Track To Myself?
- Ways to have the track to yourself include: having 8 people (a full track) in your group or paying for a full track of 8 people even if you have less participants. 
- If you book for less than 8 drivers, there may be other drivers also booked on the same track time as you. 

Can I Bring My Own Helmet?
- Yes, as long as it complies with the Australian Safety Standards.

Are alcohol or drugs allowed before driving?
- We have a 0 alcohol and drug tolerance policy, participants under the influence will not be allowed to race, and race ticket will not be refunded.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Embark on a picturesque 10-hour journey through the stunning Queen Charlotte Loop, designed for relaxation and exploration. Begin your adventure with a convenient pick-up from either Picton or Blenheim, and enjoy a scenic drive along the renowned Queen Charlotte Road, complete with breathtaking sight stops along the way. Pause for a delightful lunch in the charming town of Havelock (at your own expense) before continuing to the serene Pelorus River, a perfect spot to appreciate New Zealand's natural beauty. The journey then takes you through the heart of Marlborough wine country, where you'll visit two exceptional wineries for tastings (fees not included) and indulge your sweet tooth with a stop at a local chocolate factory. Conclude your day with a relaxing return drive to your pick-up location, leaving you with unforgettable memories of this diverse and enriching experience.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Private Chauffeur Service: Convenient pick-up and drop-off from Picton or Blenheim town areas.
- Scenic Drive: Travel along the stunning Queen Charlotte Road with stops to enjoy picturesque sights.
- Lunch Stop: Visit Havelock town for a self-arranged lunch at your chosen restaurant or our recommendation.
- Pelorus River Visit: Explore the serene beauty of the Pelorus River.
- Winery Visits: Stop at two Marlborough wineries (tasting fees not included).
- Chocolate Factory Stop: Indulge your sweet cravings with a visit to a local chocolate factory.
- Round-Trip Transport: Relax in comfort as your chauffeur ensures a smooth journey back to your pick-up location.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Please note that this experience includes transport only. All additional fees, including winery tasting fees, lunch costs, and chocolate factory purchases, are not included in the package price and will need to be arranged and paid for separately by the customer.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements:
- Attendants must be a minimum of 18 years old
- No food or alcohol in the car allowed (complimentary water provided)

field_values.redo_desc_about: Giiyong | Welcome - to Thaua Country! Connect to Country along a 3.8km trail that is part of the Gateway to the Bundian Way, where ancient stories, ceremony, breathtaking landscapes, and Aboriginal culture come alive. Begin with a traditional smoking ceremony at Jigamy, home to the Keeping Place, before venturing along a section of the Bundian Way to the breathtaking geological feature, the Pinnacles. Traverse serene coastal bushlands that open to sweeping ocean vistas, guided by Country Custodians who share their deep connection to the land. Immerse yourself in the rich knowledge systems of the local Aboriginal community, learning about plants, cultural practices, and the timeless ways of knowing that have sustained this land for thousands of years. This is more than a guided walk; it’s a profound cultural experience. By participating in this cultural tour operated by the Eden Local Aboriginal Land Council, you are helping to make a difference in our local community. Hosting these experiences provides the opportunity for intergenerational knowledge sharing and cultural pride among our people.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
Walk the Bundian Way
Learn about this ancient pathway from Turemulerrer (Twofold Bay) to Targangal (Mount Kosciuszko) that connected Aboriginal communities for trade, ceremony, and travel. Hear stories of its deep history and the vital role it played for thousands of years.
Incredible Cultural Knowledge
Be guided by a Country Custodian and hear stories of survival, tradition, and deep connection to Country, passed down for thousands of years. Learn about cultural practices, knowledge systems, and the enduring relationship between people and Country.
Diverse and Ancient Landscapes
Walk through ever-changing scenery, from dense native bushland to coastal heath and old water tables exposed by time. Experience the land’s natural beauty and geological history as you journey towards the ocean.
The Pinnacles
End your walk at this striking geological coastal formation, a breathtaking natural landmark that showcases the raw beauty of this sacred Country.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Return Vehicle Transfer from Pinnacles to Jigamy
- Traditional Smoking Ceremony
- National Park Fees
- Small Group Boutique Experience
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Fully enclosed walking shoes are a must. We also recommend sunglasses, hat, sunscreen, insect repellent, all weather clothing, water bottle, camera/mobile phone, personal medication as necessary (particularly items such as EpiPens, asthma puffers, allergy medication).
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Due to the length of the walk and the nature of the experience it is recommend for those aged 8 and above.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Please arrive 5-10 minutes prior to tour commencement to allow time for check-in. Park your vehicle in the carpark beside the Keeping Place at Jigamy and meet at the building entrance.
field_values.redo_meeting_point: Keeping Place at Jigamy, 4381 Princes Highway Broadwater
field_values.redo_desc_other: Unfortunately, the walking trail is not suitable for strollers or wheelchairs. As part of this walk traverses through Beowa National Park, National Park restrictions apply including those regarding dogs.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Welcome to McCaffrey’s Estate – a family-owned and operated boutique winery nestled in the heart of the Hunter Valley. As one of the region’s smaller producers, we pride ourselves on crafting premium, handcrafted wines that reflect the character of our vineyard and the passion behind every bottle.
With 11 acres under vine, our estate produces a diverse range of wines including Sparkling, Semillon, Verdelho, Chardonnay, Rosé, Merlot Cabernet, Cabernet Franc, Shiraz, and Fortified Wine.
During your relaxed, seated tasting experience, you’ll be guided through our wines while learning about the vineyard, our winemaking philosophy, and the unique qualities that make each variety special. Enjoy personal stories from life on the vineyard—shared with warmth, knowledge, and a genuine love for the land and the wines it produces.
