field_values.redo_desc_about:
Step aboard our newly refreshed Freedom Explorer, a meticulously maintained 20-seater glass bottom boat, kept in pristine condition above and beyond survey specifications. Stay dry and warm in comfort as you embark on an unforgettable journey, witnessing the incredible gathering of Australian Giant Cuttlefish in their natural habitat. Marvel at their mesmerising breeding cycle, as they transform, shifting colours and shapes to blend seamlessly with the oceans surroundings. Don’t just see nature - experience it like never before! Book your adventure today and launch into the wonders of the sea! We load from safe and stable boat ramps via walkways, no wet or slippery rocks, no unstable ground. Simply walk on/off. Great for elderly with knees and hips etc.
A large free car park is available and ample parking for caravans.
Look for the big timber pontoon with the walkway going down to it, located next to all the boats tied up in the marina.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
1. Skipper with Local Expertise: your skipper Steve has over 25 years of local knowledge and stories to share, so you’ll get a lot of insider insights.
2. Giant Cuttlefish Cycles: you’ll be entertained and informed about the fascinating life cycle of giant cuttlefish that arrive in the area for their mass gathering.
3. Local History: learn about the history of the area, including its past, present, and what the future may hold for the area.
4. Local Attractions & Recommendations: get the inside scoop on other things to do and see in Whyalla, so you don’t miss out on any cool spots. A fun mix of nature, history and local flavour!
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
- Warm clothing and shoes
- Camera
- Your Smile!
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Children under 15 must be accompanied by an adult over 18.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Arrive 15-20min prior departure time to check in.
field_values.redo_desc_other:
- On-site tour shop with merchandise. From warm hoodies, UV Shirts, memorabilia merchandise, glow-in-the-dark 3D printed sea creatures key chains and much more.

A: 25min from Whyalla
Q: Do you have eftpos on site?
A: Yes
Q: Can we take our dogs?
A: Yes if your dog won’t continue to bark, please advise our crew prior booking.

field_values.redo_desc_about: We start our morning with a traditional Turkish coffee and enjoy some delicious Turkish baklava, which is packed full of pistachios. We then meander through the streets of Auburn, discovering the local community. We pop into the Turkish bakehouse, enjoying some freshly baked simit, which is a sesame bagel, and we visit the local Turkish supermarket where we try so many imported, Turkish cheeses, pastrima which is Turkish pastrami, dips, the most incredible fruit jams, like fig, cherry and rose petal. We enjoy the local wood fire oven Turkish pizza, and we always offer vegetarian options.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
• Four-hour walking tour, exploring Turkish Auburn.
• We begin our tour learning the history of the region and enjoying traditional Turkish coffee.
• Experience some delicious local treats like Kazandibi, a caramelised milk pudding.
• Concluding with a traditional Turkish lunch with traditional baked pide. We cater to special diets.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
• Hand made spicy, crispy cheese-less pizza, called Lahmacun, famous street food eaten all over Turkey.
• Discover the back lanes and alleyways that only locals know.
• Visit the local Turkish baklava shop, enjoying the sweet flavours of pistachio layered pastries.
• Sample Turkish jams, cheeses, meats, and freshly made pide.
• Discover where the locals shop for imported Turkish jams and spreads.
• Learn how to shop for Turkish ingredients and products and we provide simple recipes and entertaining ideas and suggestions.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Comfortable walking shoes, water bottle, hat and sunscreen, and a shopping bag. Cash is recommended, as some places only accept currency.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Take a delicious stroll through Marrickville, where the aromas of souvlaki, moussaka, and warm pita fill the air, bringing the vibrant flavours of Greece to life! Strolling through the lively streets of Marrickville, the tantalising aromas of freshly grilled souvlaki, creamy tzatziki, and savoury moussaka fill the air, beckoning food enthusiasts to immerse themselves in the flavours of Greece. Whether you seek the comfort of hearty classics like spanakopita, a spinach and feta-filled pastry, or the refreshing delight of a Greek salad, bursting with ripe tomatoes, crisp cucumbers, olives, and creamy feta cheese, Marrickville has it all. One cannot miss the iconic gyro, a savory combination of seasoned meat, usually lamb or chicken, roasted on a vertical spit and served with warm pita bread, fresh vegetables, and a dollop of creamy tzatziki sauce. The traditional Greek hospitality is also evident in the mezze culture, where friends and family come together to share an assortment of small plates, ranging from flavourful dips like hummus and taramasalata to crispy calamari and saganaki, a delectable saganaki, fried cheese.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
• Four-hour walking tour, exploring Greek Marrickville.
• Enjoy traditional Greek coffee and homemade Greek cookies
• Sample local traditional dishes like homemade taramasalata, spanakopita.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
• Meet the locals, and the stories of their arrival to Australia from Greece.
• Discover the local deli’s where it’s like shopping in Athens
• An Authentic Yeeros, with all the trimmings

field_values.redo_desc_about:
The Real Sydney Starts Here
Forget the postcards — this isn’t polished Sydney. This is the real story, and it starts in The Rocks. Once a wild colonial outpost built on stolen land, The Rocks was carved out by convicts, ruled by rum, and soaked in scandal. On this 2.5-hour walking tour, you’ll trace the strange and staggering birth of modern Sydney — where the world’s oldest living culture collided with the most outrageous maritime gamble in British history.
Wander crooked lanes and cobbled streets. Hear true stories of escapes, disasters, ghost alleys, and the underground stream still running beneath your feet. Along the way, you’ll sample native bush flavours — like wattle seed tea and Davidson’s plum jam — for a literal taste of the land and its stories.
No boring lectures — just bloody interesting yarns told with heart and humour
Sydney’s glimmering skyline hides a grittier origin story.
was a battleground of culture, crime, and survival — and it all began
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
- Expert guide — no scripts, just sharp, surprising stories
- True tales of convicts, rebels, escapes, and resistance
- Tasting of native bush flavours — think wattle seed tea, not Vegemite
- Secret lane ways, hidden landmarks, and corners most locals miss
- Big laughs, gritty history, and a side of Sydney you won’t forget
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Expert guide — no scripts, just sharp, surprising stories
- True tales of convicts, rebels, escapes, and resistance
- Tasting of native bush flavours — think wattle seed tea, not Vegemite
- Secret lane ways, hidden landmarks, and corners most locals miss
- Big laughs, gritty history, and a side of Sydney you won’t forget
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
- Two Worlds Collide: Gadigal land vs. British colonisers — the clash that defined a nation
- Convict Chaos: From chain gangs to escape attempts so hopeless they’re hilarious (China, anyone?)
- No Money, Just Mayhem: In early Sydney, rum was currency and the pubs ruled the people
- The Tank Stream: Sydney’s lifeline turned sewer, still trickling underfoot
- Resisting the Wrecking Ball: The union legends who saved The Rocks from demolition in the 1970s
- Hidden History: Secret lanes, buried ruins, and convict bones beneath your boots
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
- Comfortable walking shoes (Sydney’s cobblestones are charming — but unforgiving)
- Water bottle
- Weather-ready gear — if it’s raining, a raincoat is better than an umbrella in tight lane ways
- A sense of humour and a taste for the unexpected
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: The Rocks is beautiful — but it’s not exactly wheelchair-friendly. Expect uneven cobblestone streets, narrow lane ways, and some steep hills or steps. If you or someone in your group has mobility concerns, please contact us in advance at [your email] or call +61 409 248 992. We’ll do our best to suggest alternate routes or ways to make it work

description: The Real Sydney Starts Here
Forget the postcards — this isn’t polished Sydney. This is the real story, and it starts in The Rocks.
Once a wild colonial outpost built on stolen land, The Rocks was carved out by convicts, ruled by rum, and soaked in scandal. On this 2.5-hour walking tour, you’ll trace the strange and staggering birth of modern Sydney — where the world’s oldest living culture collided with the most outrageous maritime gamble in British history.

Wander crooked lanes and cobbled streets. Hear true stories of escapes, disasters, ghost alleys, and the underground stream still
running beneath your feet. Along the way, you’ll sample native bush flavours — like wattle seed tea and Davidson’s plum jam — for a literal taste of the land and its stories.

No boring lectures — just bloody interesting yarns told with heart and humour
what_is_included: - Expert guide — no scripts, just sharp, surprising stories
- True tales of convicts, rebels, escapes, and resistance
- Tasting of native bush flavours — think wattle seed tea, not
Vegemite
- Secret lane ways, hidden landmarks, and corners most locals
miss
- Big laughs, gritty history, and a side of Sydney you won’t forget
itinerary: ###What You’ll Discover
Sydney’s glimmering skyline hides a grittier origin story. The Rocks
was a battleground of culture, crime, and survival — and it all began
here.

- Two Worlds Collide: Gadigal land vs. British colonisers — the
clash that defined a nation
- Convict Chaos: From chain gangs to escape attempts so
hopeless they’re hilarious (China, anyone?)
- No Money, Just Mayhem: In early Sydney, rum was currency
and the pubs ruled the people
- The Tank Stream: Sydney’s lifeline turned sewer, still trickling
underfoot
- Resisting the Wrecking Ball: The union legends who saved
The Rocks from demolition in the 1970s
- Hidden History: Secret lanes, buried ruins, and convict bones
beneath your boots 
what_to_bring: - Comfortable walking shoes (Sydney’s cobblestones are charming — but unforgiving)
- Water bottle
- Weather-ready gear — if it’s raining, a raincoat is better than an
umbrella in tight lane ways
- A sense of humour and a taste for the unexpected
restrictions: ###Mobility Note
The Rocks is beautiful — but it’s not exactly wheelchair-friendly.
Expect uneven cobblestone streets, narrow lane ways, and some
steep hills or steps.
If you or someone in your group has mobility concerns, please contact us in advance at [your email] or call +61 409 248 992.
We’ll do our best to suggest alternate routes or ways to make it
work

## Guided Heli-Fishing
## Experience the ultimate fishing adventure
Fishing like never before with a Heli-fishing adventure that takes you to the most pristine, remote locations only accessible by helicopter. Soar over rugged landscapes, vast forests, and crystal-clear waters as you’re transported to hidden fishing spots teeming with fish. With unparalleled access to secluded coastlines, you’ll have the chance to cast your line in untouched, trophy-worthy waters.
**Where the journey is as epic as the catch**
Departing from North Shore Airport, Auckland, you'll fly over the stunning islands of the Hauraki Gulf, taking in a bird’s-eye view of the dramatic land and seascape below before landing at either Great Barrier Island or the Coromandel.
Once we touch down, your expert pilot will remain with you for the entire adventure, acting as your guide on the ground. Whether you’re a seasoned fisherman or trying it out for the first time, they’ll be there to lend a hand whenever needed—so you can relax and enjoy the thrill of the catch.
After around four hours of fishing, we’ll lift off again and make our way back to Auckland, soaring over the same breathtaking landscapes—returning with your well-earned catch.
The full experience takes around 5 to 6 hours and departure times vary depending on the tide.
Feel free to request specific foods and drinks if you’d like to enhance the experience.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Discover Tasmania’s hidden gem—Leven Canyon: epic views, fresh mountain air, and a scenic escape just a short walk away! Tucked away in the heart of the northwest mountain ranges, where rolling farmlands meet untamed wilderness, lies one of Tasmania’s best-kept secrets – Leven Canyon. This awe-inspiring limestone ravine, carved over millennia by the powerful River Leven, offers visitors a chance to witness raw natural beauty in all its glory – and all within an easy 20-minute walk. Whether you're a passionate photographer, a nature enthusiast, or simply looking to breathe in some fresh mountain air, Leven Canyon delivers unforgettable views from the cliff-top lookouts, plunging over 300 meters to the river below. Get ready to disconnect from the hustle and reconnect with nature. Whether you're chasing panoramic views, keen for a peaceful walk, or looking to add a scenic highlight to your Tassie adventure, our Leven Canyon tour is a perfect choice.

field_values.redo_desc_about: A scenic watertaxi from Halfmoon Bay Wharf to Ulva Island to explore the crown jewel of the Rakiura National Park - this is a Bird Sanctuary Island with endemic species and pristine forests protected from invasive pests.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights: Departure from Halfmoon Bay Wharf to Ulva Island is a longer boat ride than from Golden Bay Wharf, it is a more scenic ride with points of interest along the way: Ackers Point - The Light House, The Ringaringa Passage (where sealions like to hang-out), Harold's Bay (the second oldest stone cottage in New Zealand).
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: A small introductory talk is given when arriving at Ulva Island to help orient you and give you an estimate of how long it takes to walk the tracks and things to watch out for.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: One cannot buy provisions on Ulva Island, please bring your own food and drink and adequate clothing.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Please bring adequate footwear and clothing, and your own food and drink.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Children must be accompanied by an adult. Please do not feed the wildlife, and take your rubbish back with you. This boat ride is not suitable for people restricted to wheelchairs, nor for people with severe back injuries, as weather can change and make the boat ride bumpy. If you are in a wheelchair but able to make a short walk of 20-50 metres to be able to get on and off the boats via the wharves, then we can facilitate the transport. Ulva Island is still a beautiful place to sit and enjoy the bird song and views so we encourage visitation.
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: 48 Hours
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Please arrive 5-10min prior to departure at Halfmoon Bay/Oban Wharf
field_values.redo_desc_other: Rakiura Adventure Ltd. reserves the right to change your departure and return times if the weather condititions or other factors are of concern to the skipper operating the vessel.
field_values.redo_booking_departure_info: Please be at Halfmoon Bay Wharf 10 minutes prior to the departure time.
field_values.redo_booking_important_info: Please ensure you have booked a return, if you have not, then Rakiura Adventure Ltd. reserves the right to book your return with the same card details as provided with the initial booking. This is to ensure we do not encroach on the agreements between providers, Department of Conservation, and The Hunter Family Trust, which requires we do have clients crossing private land outside of the hours as stipulated in this agreement. Please note, if you have booked a return under a different name, then note this in the booking notes so we can match the two bookings.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Tasmania's natural beauty as we adventure to the iconic Cradle Mountain. You will be guided by a knowledgeable and local guide, and will travel in the comfort of a modern luxury minibus. Book your adventure today and explore the hidden gems of Tasmania's stunning northwest with Coastline Tours Tasmania.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
Scenic Landscapes: Begin your journey from our breath taking beaches on the Coast and travel through the rich countryside and forests.
Wildlife Encounters: Keep an eye out for charming Wallabies, Tasmanian Devils, Echidnas, Bandicoots and our variety of birds (especially the Raptors) along the way.
Morning Tea Break: A quick rest stop to recharge along the way.
Cradle Mountain National Park Adventure Passes are included for travel to Dove Lake via the shuttle buses.
Visitor Centre Start: Begin your exploration at Cradle Mountain with a stop at the Cradle Mountain Visitors' Centre.
Shuttle Service: Enjoy the ride into the heart of Cradle Mountain National Park on the shuttle bus.
Eco-Friendly Exploration: Follow the guidance of Parks and Wildlife staff, adhere to path guidelines, and maintain a respectful distance from the wildlife (of 3 metres).
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Travel in a modern, comfortable, and air-conditioned 11 seater van.
- A friendly and local guide.
- Park entry fees.
- Shuttle bus fare.
- Morning tea or afternoon tea.
- A stop at Cradle Mountain Lodge for lunch (meals and drinks not included in ticket price and can be purchased separately by you at this location).
- Bottled water.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Meals and drinks are not included in the price of the ticket (unless otherwise specified) and can be purchased separately by you at this location.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Please wear suitable attire for diverse terrain and weather conditions. Even though it may look warm and sunny outside, please bring appropriate clothing and footwear for all seasons as the Tasmanian weather is prone to change during the day.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: This tour is not suitable for cruise passengers as we are unable to meet the cruise ship time lines.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Experience tranquillity on our Sunrise Kayak and Coffee tour. Enjoy fresh coffee, calm waters, and marvel at Sydney’s iconic views as the sun rises. Book now for a serene morning and tick off a bucket-list experience. Coffee orders are collected at booking stage, but can be changed by paddlers prior to your tour.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- All equipment including a single kayak, paddle and life-jacket.
- Passionate, experienced and friendly guides/instructors.
- Full safety briefing and kayak instruction prior to departure.
- Pre-ordered, barista-made coffee, tea or hot chocolate from a local café, provided in a splash-proof eco cup, so you can enjoy it throughout your kayak tour.
- Free digital photos, taken by your guides, emailed or Airdropped after the tour.
- Hand sanitiser and sunscreen.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
Our fun, friendly and experienced kayak guides will meet you at Lavender Bay boat ramp (just look for the bright kayaks). You’ll be fitted with a life jacket and will be given a safety briefing and kayak instruction, before heading out on to the water to watch the sun hit the horizon beneath the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
Beautiful Lavender Bay and Blues Point foreshore are the perfect places to watch the city come to life. From November to January the sun rises early, so paddlers can enjoy a kayak under the Sydney Harbour Bridge. In our cooler months, we’ll head to Goat Island or Sawmillers Reserve, bathing in the warm rays of the morning sun, enjoying the iconic views along the way. Regardless of the time of year, we guarantee epic photos of you in your kayak, with the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House as your backdrop.. and a hot coffee!
We’ll take care of the little things, with your hot barista-made coffee and friendly, experienced Guides, who will take lots of photos with the best of Sydney in the background.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
Arrive 10 minutes before the tour start time.
Just like a trip to the beach you will need sunscreen, water, hat, sunglasses and comfortable kayaking clothes that you don’t mind getting a little wet from paddle splash.
Thongs/flip flops are ok in the kayak, but water shoes are highly recommended to protect you from oyster shells on the beach.
field_values.redo_desc_duration_text: Allow 2 hours (90 minutes on the water)
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: This is an all-weather experience—we paddle rain or shine. Sunrise tours run at sunrise; others usually start at 9:30am. We only cancel if conditions are unsafe. Please review our full Terms & Conditions and Cancellation Policy.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Meet at Lavender Bay Boat Ramp via Railway Ave under the rail arch. From King George St, take the stairs down.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Looking for a unique and authentic wine experience? A fun birthday celebration with your besties? A boozy brewery tour with the boys? A family fun day with the whole tribe! Well we like to think we do it all pretty well and would love to roll you around the region!! Our Private Tours are perfect for groups of all sizes. We’ll work with you to create a fully customised experience tailored to the requirements of your group. With around 100 cellar doors to choose from and a selection of superb dining experiences, breweries, distillers and providores the options are endless. field_values.redo_desc_about:
Set sail on a one-of-a-kind adventure where cosmic mystery meets breathtaking scenery! Our UFO Festival Boat Tour invites you to drift through the region's most stunning waterways while uncovering the legends of unexplained sightings that have made this area a hotspot for UFO enthusiasts worldwide.
As we cruise along tranquil Hinchinbrook Channel and winding rivers, you'll be surrounded by awe-inspiring natural beauty of Hinchinbrook Islands landscapes—towering forests, mirror-like water, and dramatic skies that seem tailor-made for a close encounter. Our expert guides will share riveting stories of strange lights, eerie encounters, and local legends tied to real UFO sightings that have puzzled residents and researchers for decades.
Whether you're a believer, a skeptic, or just in it for the views, this tour offers something truly out of this world. Soak in the beauty. Watch the skies. You never know what might appear just over the treetops…

field_values.redo_desc_what_included: The 2024 Sea-Doo RXP-X 325 is a high-performance personal watercraft built for speed and precision, powered by the new 325 hp Rotax 1630 ACE engine—the most powerful in the Sea-Doo lineup. At GC Jet Ski Hire, our premium jet ski experiences start from $1,000.
To ensure a safe and smooth hire process, we require a security bond for all bookings. This bond is processed as a pre-authorisation hold on the card you use to book, and is placed either the day before or on the day of your rental.
💳 What You Need to Know:
- Make sure your card has sufficient available funds to cover the hold.
- The bond is in place to cover any potential damage or refuelling requirements during your hire.
- If the ski is returned on time, fully fuelled, and in the same condition, the full amount is released back to your card.
Release times can vary depending on your bank, typically 3–7 business days.
Enjoy peace of mind knowing your bond is fully refundable when the gear comes back as it went out.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Join us on the Southern Hemisphere's first and only fully-electric passenger ferry; Ika Rere - for a zero emissions tour of Wellington Harbour.
Learn about the history of Te Whanganui-a-Tara/Wellington as the capital city, our local maritime history and natural environment as we take you on a 90 minute cruise around the harbour.
Our tour takes in different parts of the harbour depending on conditions on the day. We're the busiest operator on Wellington Harbour at over 9,000 crossings per year, so our team knows where to go to take in all the best sights, regardless of conditions.
accessibility: Our vessels have steep stairs and gangways; if you have any accessibility concerns or special requirements, please get in touch with our customer service team before you travel with us.
Unfortunately our ferries / wharves are not wheelchair accessible.

Departures from the city
Zero Emissions

Departs from Queens Wharf, Central Wellington.

Make use of our fully licensed onboard bar (additional charges apply).
Arrive back at Queens Wharf.

Waterfront Café & Restaurant – Indulge in delicious meals and refreshing drinks with a stunning view.

Souvenir Shop – Take home a piece of the orchard with locally made treats and gifts.

field_values.redo_desc_about: NEW in 2025 is the Whale Trail Full Day Guided EBiking Wine Tour. This tour is designed for keen and experienced cyclists. This is a group tour with a maximum of 8pax (not private). Departing from our Blenheim Central base, our friendly local guide will fit guests with modern eBikes; then guide guests along scenic cycle paths to Yealands Estate (hilly, approximately 40km), in the Awatere Valley. Along the way, experience a winery tour and tasting and stop for morning tea. Arriving at the iconic Yealands Cellar Door, guests will reward their hard work with a wine tasting! You will to ride the iconic ‘White Roads’ through the vineyards, along the spectacular coast. Riding approximately 7.5km along gentle hilly gravel paths, including animal feeding, coastal lookout with bubbles, butterfly gully and a stop for lunch (gourmet picnic and wine included). Our guide will then drive guests back to Blenheim. We ride along gravel roads and through vineyards. The tour guides provides commentary throughout the tour on the wines, history and geography of NZ's largest wine region.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
▪ Cycle through beautiful scenery to visit the iconic Yealands Estate winery and ride the White Roads.
▪ A fully informed interesting local guide plus Yealands host.
▪ Picnic lunch, all wine and tastings an animal food included in tour cost.
▪ This moderate to difficult 50km total cycling distance with hills ensures that keen and experienced cyclists will love this tour.
▪ Modern, comfortable step through E-Bikes with helmets and safety vests.
▪ This tour bikes along cycle paths, county roads and through vineyards ensuring that contact with traffic is minimized as much as possible.
▪ Provides a great alternative to a driving tour and allows client to combine tasting with their passion for cycling.

field_values.redo_desc_about: A full day on the water traveling offshore to explore the continental shelf deep water drop-off in search of pelagic species such as offshore dolphins, whales, sharks and abundant bird life.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights: Possible species we'll encounter are common dolphins, bottlenose dolphins, Risso's dolphins, false killer whales, pilot whales, killer whales, sperm whales and beaked whales. Fur Seals and Penguins. Petrels, shearwaters, terns and albatrosses may be seen along the way. These offshore expeditions are a great opportunity for photographing rarely seen marine mammals and seabirds, providing a memorable experience.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: Become a “Marine Explorer” citizen scientist: You can assist in the collection of data for research on marine life on the South Coast, focusing on cetaceans and birdlife.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Departing Greenwell Point wharf as the sunrises. The vessel will travel from shallow coastal waters out to the edge of the Continental Shelf. Returning at approximately 3:30-4:00pm (weather permitting, skipper will make the call regarding the weather the day before). (departure time will change as daylight hours in Winter)
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Warm clothing, wet weather gear, hat, sunglasses, sunscreen. camera, binoculars, water bottle, your lunch and extra snacks. Hot-water is available for tea or coffee and of course bring a happy smile! If you get seasick, please take precautions.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Seasickness: As you will be in the open ocean the wave height and swell can change with weather conditions. If you are in doubt consult your doctor or pharmacist as to the remedies available. We do not provide seasickness remedies. To help prevent seasickness: 1. Get a full night’s sleep the night before the day trip on the water. 2. Eat a good breakfast before leaving. 3. Take remedies as directed – before leaving the wharf. 4. Standing up to get you stabilised when on board and remain outside in fresh air. 5. Looking at the horizon will helps control your balance. 6. Keep yourself busy scanning the water for a sighting and observing the conditions. 7. Eat solid foods for lunch, snacking (biscuits and bread rolls) over the day and drinking water will help balance your sustainability while on board.
field_values.redo_desc_other: *Just remember the boat won’t turn around and drop you off if you are sick.
field_values.redo_booking_what_to_bring:
Warm cloths, jacket, hat, sunscreen, camera, binoculars, bottle of water and snacks if you need.
Closed footwear (NO thongs or open shoes)

field_values.redo_desc_about: Our Marine Discovery Centre showcases an expanded range of themed fish and animals like sharks, octopus and coral aquariums plus our amazing 360-degree Digital Dolphinarium, as well as a fascinating Interpretation of the Koombana Bay environment and its history – geological, indigenous, marine and contemporary. Your ticket is valid for the whole calendar day (9am - 3pm), we recommend 90 minutes but feel free to stay longer! It is an immersive experience, with activity centres, interactive displays, feeding programs (4 times daily) and tours that appeal to all age groups. The aquariums tell the story of our region from freshwater river to offshore reef and feature the marine plants and animals of our temperate zone. The centre provides a unique experience that uses embedded technology along with natural displays to create a memorable experience for visitors that complements the wild dolphin experience of our beach Interaction Zone and Dolphin Tours. The Dolphin Discovery Centre works with the wild Bottlenose dolphins of Koombana Bay and is dedicated to conservation, research and education. The centre is a not for profit organisation and thrives on the generosity of about 100 volunteers. If the dolphins choose to visit the Interaction Zone outside the centre we will make sure we let you know. It's a great opportunity to see wild dolphins in their natural environment. There are no dolphins in aquariums or ocean pens!

- Touch-and-learn activity zones
- Octopus & rescue turtle feedings
- Digital Dolphinarium immersion

field_values.redo_desc_about: Dolphins lives are at risk from human impact. You can help support our conservation projects and make a real difference to a dolphins life by a adopting a dolphin today. Scout is our fabulous Swim and Eco Tour star. She is mainly seen out around the Cut since we first met her in 2004 as a juvenile. Scout is a great mum. She has five healthy calves in the Bay, Hunter, Ranger, Decoy, Ambush, and Lookout. In February 2022, just a week after giving birth to little Ambush, her oldest daughter Hunter gave birth to Scout’s first grandchild, Tracker. After only 2 years she weaned Ambush and had Lookout. Please adopt Scout today!
field_values.redo_desc_other:

**Dolphin Adoption ($75/Year):** You will be e-mailed a printable certificate, rehabilitation photo, fact sheet, and you get a E-Newsletter subscription.
**Dolphin Adoption Gift Pack ($125/Year):** You will be mailed an Adoption Certificate, Photo, Dolphin Plush Toy, Fact Sheet, and get a E-Newsletter subscription.
**Dolphin Premium Adoption Pack ($1,000/Year):** You will receive 2*Annual Family (2ad/2ch) Passes to the Marine Discovery & Interpretive Centre (transferable as a gift), Plush Toy, Certificate, Photo, 1 VIP Trip for 4 people behind the scenes of the Dolphin Discovery Centre and our Research/Conservation work, E-Newsletter, fact sheet on our program.

field_values.redo_desc_about: The Farmers Market Experience - Pedals and Picnics newest experience. Our new Murwillumbah Farmers Market Experience is the perfect way to start your Wednesday morning. It’s an exciting new twist on our popular DIY combo deal, designed for those who love fresh food and a touch of adventure.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: This experience includes the full DIY combo deal—two eBikes or push bikes for the full day, a DIY picnic setting, and your custom grazing box. Plus 2 flavoured spring waters.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Meet Us at 8am: Your adventure begins bright and early at the start of the Northern Rivers Rail Trail. We will drive you to Murwillumbah Farmers Market in our bus. Explore and Enjoy: You'll have time to walk the market, selecting your own farm-fresh produce to create a personalized picnic. You'll also be treated to a light breakfast and coffee while listening to a local artist perform. Pack Your Picnic: We'll head back to the Northern Rivers Rail Trail where your selected produce will be packed into a insulated picnic basket, ready for your ride. Ride and Picnic: Now the trail is yours to explore! Find the perfect spot to enjoy your handmade picnic.

description: The Farmers Market Experience - Pedals and Picnics newest experience.

Our new Murwillumbah Farmers Market Experience is the perfect way to start your Wednesday morning. It’s an exciting new twist on our popular DIY combo deal, designed for those who love fresh food and a touch of adventure.

what_is_included: Here's how it works:

Meet Us at 8am: Your adventure begins bright and early at the start of the Northern Rivers Rail Trail.

We will drive you to Murwillumbah Farmers Market in our bus.

Explore and Enjoy: You'll have time to walk the market, selecting your own farm-fresh produce to create a personalized picnic. You'll also be treated to a light breakfast and coffee while listening to a local artist perform.

Pack Your Picnic: We'll head back to the Northern Rivers Rail Trail where your selected produce will be packed into a insulated picnic basket, ready for your ride.

Ride and Picnic: Now the trail is yours to explore! Find the perfect spot to enjoy your handmade picnic.

This experience includes the full DIY combo deal—two eBikes or push bikes for the full day, a DIY picnic setting, and your custom grazing box. Plus 2 flavoured spring waters.This is great value for a day of fun, food, and cycling.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
The North Coast of New South Wales is famous for its beaches, many being excellent fishing spots. These stunning beaches are home to bream, tarwhine, whiting, flat head, dart, mulloway and many other recreational fish species.
Our guides have many years of experience guiding fishing trips and know the area well. They love to share their local knowledge and help participants gain the skills they need to become successful beach or estuary anglers. Your fishing guide will tailor this private trip to suit your needs and experience level. Book today!

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Splitters Farm is a photographer's dream as one of our farm guides takes you inside the paddocks to get up close and personal with the beautiful rescue animals of Splitters Farm. You'll taste locally produced honey and macadamias, collect eggs, and learn all about the history of Splitters Farm and its animals.
Once you finish your tour you are welcome to stay on a BYO picnic to enjoy in our beautiful gardens.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Farm Entry Ticket.
- This Guided tour takes you from paddock to paddock meeting our farm animals with one of our friendly farm guides.
- Hand Feeding & Food for our animals.
- Over 400 beautiful rescue animals of Splitters Farm.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Hire items are charged an additional cost and can be booked at the Main Site Office.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
Please arrive 10min prior to your allocated session time to partake in one of the hourly safety briefings.
After the tour feel free to hire a go kart, explore the orchard, take a swim in the dam or discover the creek via kayak.

field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Please arrive ready 5min before your allocated time slot. While a group safety briefing will occur each hour on the hour, your entry entitles you to use the grounds until closing time on the day of your booking.

description: ##Duration
2.5 hours (return, including tour time)

##About

Step into history and celebration these school holidays with DownsSteam’s Carnival Railmotor Adventure – a short but memorable family journey that combines the beauty of the Carnival of Flowers with the charm of heritage rail travel.

Departing from the grand Toowoomba Railway Station, you’ll travel aboard DownsSteam’s exquisitely restored Commissioner Railmotors to Drayton, home of DownsSteam Tourist Railway & Museum. Here, guests will enjoy:

A guided tour of our award-winning gardens, museum, and Dreamtime Journey Coach.

An exclusive behind-the-scenes look inside our active workshop.

The opportunity to step aboard restored heritage carriages and learn their stories.

Time to relax at our café and sausage sizzle, perfect for families and groups.

At 1:00 pm, your railmotor departs Drayton for the return journey to Toowoomba, completing a unique 2.5-hour holiday adventure designed for locals, visitors, and families seeking a fun and educational outing.

#More Info

Originally reserved for Queensland Railway Executives, the Commissioner Railmotors offer a rare chance to travel in comfort and style. Sit behind the drivers and watch the line ahead through panoramic windscreens, or simply enjoy the charm of classic rail travel.

#Trip Itinerary

11:00 am – Depart Toowoomba Railway Station aboard the Commissioner Railmotors

11:30 am – 1:00 pm – Tour DownsSteam’s gardens, museum, Dreamtime Journey Coach, and workshop, with café and sausage sizzle available

1:00 pm – Depart Drayton for the return journey

1:30 pm – Arrive back at Toowoomba Railway Station

##Additional Info

Please plan to arrive at Toowoomba Railway Station at least 30 minutes before departure.

This trip starts and finishes at Toowoomba Railway Station in the centre of town, please ensure all guests navigate to Toowoomba Railway Station.

Onboard toilets are available on both railmotors.

Concession fares are not available for this trip.

We will endeavour to honour advance seating requests; however, seating may be reassigned at any time for operational, safety, or other reasonable purposes.

#Accessibility
Unfortunately, due to the era of the Railmotors, wheelchair access is not available. Access requires using steps into the carriages.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
The stunning coastal journey from Ōtepoti Dunedin to Oamaru and the Waitaki Valley, with its geographic, historic and architectural gems, is one of Ōtākou’s best kept secrets.
Starting in Aotearoa’s oldest city Ōtepoti Dunedin, you will embark on a scenic journey visiting historic viewpoints and significant landmarks, including the stunning Karitane peninsular - the site of a significant and early Māori settlement - and the Moeraki Boulders, other-worldly spherical concretions formed 65 million years ago. In Oamaru, you will visit an international award-winning whiskey distillery, boutique breweries, the best (literally!) cheese producer in Aotearoa NZ, and other artisanal food producers located in Oamaru’s heritage precinct.
accessibility: Our tours are easy access with limited walking, but some stairs may be included
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
- Small group, ensuring personalised care and service
- Travel in the comfort and 5-star safety of 2025 GWM Tank 300
- Spectacular coastal drive with historic and geographic significance
- Sample internationally acclaimed whiskies, and uniquely NZ beers and wine
- Taste New Zealand’s best cheeses and cured meats at Whitestone Cheese
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Door to door hotel, Dunedin airport or Port Otago pickup and drop-off
- Professional, local guide
- Complimentary onboard Wi-Fi and unlimited local spring water
- Stops along the way at historically and culturally significant sites and viewpoints for photo opportunities and commentary on regional history and culture
- Tastings at internationally recognised NZ Whiskey Collection; Craftwork, Scott’s or Arc Breweries
- Shared artisanal cheese and charcuterie tasting platter accompanied with a glass of NZ wine at the award-winning Whitestone Cheese factory
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Any additional food or drink not specified in the tour
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
Southern NZ can enjoy 20 degrees in the morning and 5 degrees in the afternoon (or vice versa)! We recommend you check your weather app before departure and bring appropriate clothing.
Although we are happy to provide bottled water for the journey, we are environmentally conscious Kiwis, so if you’ve got a refillable water bottle – please bring it and we can refill from our spring water tank in the back of the vehicle.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: For personal space reasons, this tour is limited to 3 people, but if you can get a group of 4 people together, and don’t mind three people in the back seat, then please book our private tour option for 4 people which attracts a 10% discount.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Your pickup details will appear on the confirmation email sent after booking. Please be ready 10 minutes before designated pick-up time at your preferred pickup location.
field_values.redo_meeting_point: Dunedin accomodation or Port/airport of Dunedin pick up and drop off is included
field_values.redo_booking_contact: If you have any questions, special requests, or changes prior to the tour commencing, please don’t hesitate to contact us at info@tastelocal.nz or text/WhatsApp us directly on +64 290 456 0991.
field_values.redo_booking_other:
Kia ora!
Thank you so much for choosing Taste Local as your preferred guide. We appreciate that you have options, so we’re delighted you have chosen us to share our beautiful slice of Southern Aotearoa NZ with you.
We look forward to seeing you very soon!
Thank you, ngā manaakitanga,
The Taste Local Team

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Our premium pontoon is the ultimate way to enjoy Mandurah’s waterways in comfort and style. This spacious vessel features plush seating, a large deck area, and smooth, stable cruising – perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or celebrating special occasions. Whether you’re exploring the canals, spotting dolphins, or anchoring at Boundary Island for a swim, the pontoon provides an unbeatable balance of freedom and luxury. Equipped with all required safety gear and powered by a reliable engine, it’s designed for effortless handling so you can simply focus on the experience. Gather friends and family, pack a picnic or esky, and enjoy an unforgettable day on the water.
faqs: # Do I need a skippers ticket or boat license?
Yes, life jackets are provided for all children and adults.
# What time do I need to arrive?
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
Hiring a premium pontoon turns an ordinary day into something extraordinary. With spacious seating, open decks, and smooth cruising, it’s designed for comfort – so everyone on board can truly relax and enjoy the journey.
The real magic is in the freedom it gives you. Cruise through Mandurah’s famous canals, spot dolphins playing alongside, or drop anchor at Boundary Island for a swim. Every trip is unique, offering new sights and experiences.
It’s also the perfect way to bring people together. Whether it’s a birthday, family outing, or just a day of sunshine with friends, a pontoon creates the space to laugh, share food and drinks, and make memories that last.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
* Safety briefing and instruction on how to drive the vessel and navigate the local area.
* All fuel is included in the price.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded:
* Excess waiver is an optional add-on to reduce liability
* Merchandise such as Captain Hats can be purchased separately.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
1. Arrive 20-30 minutes before your hire start time to complete the waiver and check-in process.
2. Your safety briefing will start at the beginning of your hire time and take between 5-20 minutes depending on your experience.
3. You can then spend the rest of your hire on the water.
4. Return to our jetty before the end of your hire to ensure you have enough time to disembark with all your belongings before the hire ends.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
* Sunscreen
* Hats
* Sunglasses
* Jackets through winter
* Fishing equipment
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: No, a Recreational Skippers Ticket is only required for night-time hires.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: You should arrive at least 15-20 minutes before your hire.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Discover Wallagoot Lake at Night
Our Night Kayaking Tour is the Sapphire Coast's best kept secret. Discover the magic and adventure of night kayaking on the tranquil and protected Wallagoot lake. Just a short drive from Merimbula (20 minutes) and Tathra (15 minutes), this tour offers a truly unique perspective on the natural world.
We'll begin at the Wallagoot Lake Sailing Club and prepare for our night adventure. As we paddle toward the mouth of the lake, you'll glide through a beautiful wetland area bustling with seabirds like pelicans, black swans, cormorants, and sea eagles. The sandy dunes along the shore are a great spot to see kangaroos as they come out to graze at dusk.
After enjoying sunset, we'll stop for a delicious supper on the shore. You'll feast on a platter featuring local Tilba cheese, crackers, and seasonal fruit, along with a selection of hot drinks and orange juice.
As the sun disappears and the stars begin to emerge, we'll make our way back. This is when the lake truly comes alive. Listen for the chorus of frogs and the rustle of evening birds. Using our special underwater light, we'll search for fish, prawns, jellyfish, and even stingrays in the shallow, protected waters below. With lights on each kayak, we'll paddle safely back together, savouring this surreal and serene experience.
The timing of this tour varies with the seasons, as it's perfectly timed to coincide with the sunset. This makes for a later start in the summer, but a fantastic experience for the entire family.
Supporting Conservation
$1 from every tour will be donated to South Coast Wildlife Rescue to support their vital work in this region.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- sit on top kayak and equipment
- Supper: local cheese and hot drink
- 3hrs expert kayak guide
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
Hat, sunglasses, reef-safe sunscreen
Full bottle of water
A head torch or similar
Closed-toe shoes (reef shoes or old trainers) are needed. We have some you can borrow.
Wear a shirt with shorts or 3/4 length pants. Bring warm layers if it's cold. We have rain gear you can borrow. If you plan to swim, wear your swimmers and bring a towel.
Extra Clothes: Even in the middle of summer, evenings can get cool. We recommend wearing layers and bringing a spare change of clothes, which you can store in a dry bag we'll provide.
Insect Repellent: Bugs tend to come out at twilight. We have a natural repellent for you to use. If you prefer to bring your own, please use it away from other guests and our equipment and avoid products containing DEET.
field_values.redo_booking_departure_info: Please arrive 10 minutes prior.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Enjoy a relaxed afternoon discovering some of Marlborough’s award-winning wineries and boutique cellar doors on this small-group wine experience. Visiting three to four carefully selected venues, you’ll enjoy guided tastings of Marlborough’s world-famous Sauvignon Blanc along with a variety of other locally produced wines. Your tour also includes time to unwind at a beautiful vineyard restaurant where guests may purchase an à la carte lunch while taking in the stunning vineyard surroundings. Designed around quality over quantity, this social and personalised experience includes pickup and return from central Blenheim and Renwick accommodation, making it the perfect way to enjoy an afternoon in Marlborough wine country.

Small-group Marlborough wine experience
Visit 3–4 boutique and award-winning cellar doors
Taste Marlborough’s world-famous Sauvignon Blanc and premium varietals
Relaxed vineyard lunch stop (lunch at guests’ own expense)
Scenic vineyard landscapes throughout the afternoon
All standard cellar door tasting fees included
Optional visit to Makana Boutique Chocolate Factory time permitting
Pickup and return from selected Blenheim & Renwick accommodation

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Very simple class for everyone!
Our ceramic plate classes include rolling out the clay into a slab, then using our plastic plate template to cut your circle and lay your piece into the template. Easy!
It leaves plenty of time for you to paint and decorate your plate in a nice Christmas theme!
Paint holly leaves, Santa's face, a Christmas tree, or create little dividers and paint some cookies on one side and carrots on the other! Santa will be super impressed finding his treats on a handmade plate!
Pieces will be ready for pick-up 4 to 5 weeks later.
We cannot have them ready by Christmas day, but at least your ceramic plate will be long-lasting and can be used for years to come!
If you'd prefer something to take home on the same day - we have plenty of air-dry clay workshops!

- Underglaze colours for painting your design
- Ideas and instructions
- Aprons, tools and some inspiration from our teachers!
- Best of all, you walk out without having to clean anything up :)

field_values.redo_desc_about: Paddle, hike, and explore a dormant volcano just minutes from Auckland in a scenic kayak adventure to Browns Island. Embark on a scenic paddling journey from St. Heliers Beach, just 20 minutes from downtown Auckland. After a safety briefing, set off on a 45-minute kayak trip across the sparkling waters to Browns Island, a dormant volcano rich in history and geological wonders. Upon arrival, your guide will lead you on a summit hike, where you’ll take in breathtaking views of East Auckland, the Hauraki Gulf, and fascinating archaeological sites. Enjoy a well-earned rest at the peak before exploring more of the island’s unique landscape. Weather permitting, you’ll circumnavigate the island by kayak before paddling back along the stunning cliffs of Gentlemen’s Bay. Expect to return to St. Heliers Beach around 2 p.m., feeling accomplished and refreshed from this incredible adventure on the water.

field_values.redo_desc_about: This relaxed afternoon tour offers a leisurely way to taste Marlborough’s world-class wines without a full-day commitment. With a 12:30 pm pickup you’ll visit four hand-picked cellar doors, sampling a selection of wines from crisp Sauvignon Blanc to elegant Pinot Noir. Expect to return between 4:00–4:30 pm, having discovered the flavours and style that make New Zealand’s most famous wine region so celebrated.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
* Taste Marlborough’s signature Sauvignon Blanc and regional Pinot Noir
* Four curated cellar-door visits for a relaxed afternoon of discovery
* Option to pre-order sharing platters for a light bite alongside tastings
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Platters are available by pre-order only and are not included in the standard tour price.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:

2. Visit and tasting at cellar door 1
3. Visit and tasting at cellar door 2
4. Visit and tasting at cellar door 3

6. Return between 4:00–4:30 pm
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Guests must be 18 or older to participate.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Pickup at 12:30 pm; meeting point provided at booking. Return to drop-off between 4:00–4:30 pm.
field_values.redo_desc_other: Tour order and cellar-door visits may vary depending on availability. Return time is approximate and may vary with traffic.
field_values.redo_booking_departure_info: Pick up in our minibus from your hotel / motel or centrally in Blenheim at 12.30pm for this Afternoon Wine Tour around Marlborough. Pick ups from outside Blenheim can be arranged.
field_values.redo_booking_itinerary:
- Travel through the scenic beauty of the Marlborough vineyards where internationally famous wineries produce their multi-award winning Sauvignon Blancs and Pinot Noirs and a wide range of other varietals.
- Tastings at 4 wineries of your choice or be guided by us to a selection of corporate wineries and boutique family run cellar doors.
- Platters can be pre-ordered if you’d like to enjoy a bite alongside your tastings, but a full lunch is not included—making this an easygoing option for travelers who’ve already had a meal or prefer a lighter experience.
- Return to Blenheim at about 4.30pm.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Curious about stained glass? Join us for an introductory **two day** stained glass workshop with visiting UK glass artist Jan Simpson. Perfect for beginners wanting to explore the art of stained glass, you will learn foundational techniques for working with stained glass including glass cutting, soldering, cementing and polishing. Students will learn shop safety, be introduced to the shop, tools, materials and techniques used in stained glass. Students will have the opportunity to apply those skills to create their very own using the techniques taught in the class. All glass creations are the student's to keep at the end of the class.
You’ll have a choice of two designs, each offering a different set of challenges to help you understand how to approach your own original designs in future.
Originally from New Zealand, she blends traditional, heritage craftsmanship with contemporary techniques to explore light, colour, and form.
Jan works to commission and teaches from her Bognor Regis studio.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: All required materials and tools to complete the projects will be provided by the studio and included in the course fees.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Day 1 - AM - Introduction to design methods, measuring techniques and materials used to create a stained glass window panel. Cutting techniques, using 3mm glass, students will learn how to use a variety of glass cutting tools to achieve precise lines and curves, and how to approach glass cutting for stained glass. - PM : Students will select their design, choose their coloured glass, and will have their completed glass panels cut and ready for leading up the following day. Day 2 - AM - Students will be introduced to leading techniques, tools and materials required to commence leading their panel. They will learn how to use the grinder if necessary. - PM - Students will complete leading their panel and will then be taken through the processes used for soldering and cementing their panel. The completed panel will be taken home by the student for final polishing up at home once the cement has dried. A demonstration of this will be shown at the end of the day and a fully written handout will be supplied to each student for them to take away for future reference.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Students are asked to wear cotton or natural material clothing, long pants, and close toed shoes. Please bring a water bottle, and snacks/lunch to keep energy levels up!

676702.raw_desc:
meeting_point: Amokura Glass
description: #2 Day Introduction to Stained Glass with Jan Simpson 

##Duration
10am - 4:30pm (6.5 hours) over **2 consecutive days**
13 hours total

- 6 & 7 February (SOLD OUT)
- 8 & 9 February
- 11 & 12 February

##Requirements
Must be 14+ years old. 
Ages 14 & 15 must be accompanied by an adult

##About - Introduction to Stained Glass
Curious about stained glass? Join us for an introductory **two day** stained glass workshop with visiting UK glass artist Jan Simpson. Perfect for beginners wanting to explore the art of stained glass, you will learn foundational techniques for working with stained glass including glass cutting, soldering, cementing and polishing.

##What you’ll do
Over two days, you’ll create a stained glass panel using leaded techniques. You’ll have a choice of two designs, each offering a different set of challenges to help you understand how to approach your own original designs in future. This workshop is suitable for a complete beginner, or those ready to build on previous experience.

**You’ll learn how to:**
- Approach and create a design in glass
- Measure, cut, and handle glass safely
- Select and cut coloured glass pieces
- Lead, solder, cement, and polish your finished stained glass panel

__________________________________________________________
**Day 1**
- AM - Introduction to design methods, measuring techniques and materials used to create a stained glass window panel. Cutting techniques, using 3mm glass, students will learn how to use a variety of glass cutting tools to achieve precise lines and curves, and how to approach glass cutting for stained glass.
- PM : Students will select their design, choose their coloured glass, and will have their completed glass panels cut and ready for leading up the following day.
__________________________________________________________

**Day 2**
- AM - Students will be introduced to leading techniques, tools and materials required to commence leading their panel. They will learn how to use the grinder if necessary.
- PM - Students will complete leading their panel and will then be taken through the processes used for soldering and cementing their panel.

The completed panel will be taken home by the student for final polishing up at home once the cement has dried. A demonstration of this will be shown at the end of the day and a fully written handout will be supplied to each student for them to take away for future reference.
__________________________________________________________

##About the Artist
Jan Simpson is a UK-based glass artist with over 30 years of experience, specializing in bespoke stained and fused glass. Originally from New Zealand, she blends traditional, heritage craftsmanship with contemporary techniques to explore light, colour, and form. Jan works to commission and teaches from her Bognor Regis studio.

##Objective
Students will learn shop safety, be introduced to the shop, tools, materials and techniques used in stained glass. Students will have the opportunity to apply those skills to create their very own using the techniques taught in the class. All glass creations are the student's to keep at the end of the class.

##Prerequisites
No previous experience in glass or stained glass required, class is open to all interested parties. Ages 14+

##Materials & Supplies
All required materials and tools to complete the projects will be provided by the studio and included in the course fees. Students are asked to wear cotton or natural material clothing, long pants, and close toed shoes. Please bring a water bottle, and snacks/lunch to keep energy levels up!

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Affectionately admired hand-painted ceramics? Take home your pieces to proudly display on the table when you attend this Sydney class!
In this three-hour class, you will paint your design on a plate, a bowl, or a mug. Underglaze paints, firings, and glazing are all included in our all-inclusive session.
Come with your own designs or choose one of the many pieces we have already painted up, and we will guide you in a step-by-step instruction class for beginners, to recreate something you will be proud to display.
When you are done with your creation, you can leave it with us, and we will fire and glaze it. Our studio will have them available for pick-up approximately 14 days after the class, so you can use them right away! These pieces can go into the dishwasher and microwave as well.

- Paint your own design onto a plate, bowl or mug
- Beginner-friendly step-by-step instruction
- All materials, firing and glazing included
- Dishwasher and microwave-safe finished pieces
- Collect your finished ceramics about 14 days after class
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Underglaze paints
- Firings
- Glazing

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Unlock some of New Zealand’s longest and highest mountain bike trails with a Cardrona 2 day mountain biking lift pass. Ride lift-accessed terrain reaching up to 1860m elevation, with two chairlifts giving access to two basins packed with flow and technical trails for every level.
Descend a thrilling 345 vertical metres on trails designed to challenge and excite, including the iconic 10km peak-to-pub run. Whether you're just building confidence, mastering technical features, or just soaking in the alpine views, Cardrona delivers an unforgettable ride.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
The highest and longest descents in New Zealand
Flow and technical trails for all levels, from beginner to expert

- Two basins, two chairlifts, and endless downhill adventure

- Warm layers, the mountain can be colder than in town

- People with back problems

- People with pre-existing medical conditions

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Lake Hayes Show is the event of the season, a quintessential queenstown experience! Our show camp provides all the know how, pony and rider prep, transport, and show day guidance. Riders to have a parent or guardian present while at the show. Riders camp over Friday night so that they are on site and ready to go bright and early Saturday morning.
Riders must wear long pants and a top that covers their shoulders when riding
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Note that cost does not include your entry fee for the show, however we will assist you in completing your entry form.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Friday - Morning Group Q&A, lesson, then pony prep & care, packing, potluck dinner & camp set up. Saturday - Early morning wake up, load ponies and travel to the show with breakfast on the go, pony & rider prep, warm up, show time! Customary end of day lake swim with the ponies before heading back to base.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring:
- Warm layers
- Waterproof layers
- Waterbottle
- Closed toed sturdy footwear
- Changes of clothes for each day - riding and relaxing
- Swimming togs and towel
- Show day outfit
- Sunscreen
- Sunhat
- Tent (can be shared between friends)
- Sleeping bag & pillow
- Toiletries
If bringing your own horse, bring feed and hay to last the two days, multiple rug options, tack, spare saddle blanket, hay net, large waterbucket etc. Ensure horses are fit, healthy, freshly shod/trimmed, up to date on worming, and that tack fits correctly and comfortably.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Riders to be accompanied by a parent or guardian while at the show. Parents to play an active roll on show day helping their rider get ready and keeping them fed and hydrated on the day.
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: Bookings are non refundable
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Arrive: 9am Friday 9th January
field_values.redo_desc_other:
By completing your registration and making a booking, you:
- Agree to follow all facility policies and procedures.
- Acknowledge that there are livestock present on the property including dogs, horses, and other farm animals, and that these can be unpredictable by nature, with their actions able to cause injury or death to an affected person.
- Accept that horse riding, falls from horses, and associated handling of equines carries inherent risks to yourself or your child's safety, which may cause injury or death.
- Indemnify A M Equestrian from liability of these risks.
FAQs: Can I bring my own horse?
- Yes! Or ride one of ours.
Do I need to have show experience?
- No! This outing is fully supported by our staff, allowing first time showies to make their debut.
Do I need to have a fancy show outfit?
- Only in the "open" rings (the fancy ones), the entry level rings only require you to be clean, tidy, and safe.
Does my child have to stay over on Friday night?
- No, however be ready for a very early start on Saturday otherwise!

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Step into the world of Killara Single Malt Whisky with our exclusive Whisky Blending Experience. This relaxed and engaging journey invites you to explore whisky in a new and exciting way as you craft your own signature whisky. Guided by the Killara team, you will learn about whisky distillation, cask selection, maturation and the art and skill of creating whisky from start to finish. field_values.redo_desc_about: Our NDIS School Holiday Zookeeper Program gives young autistic people the chance to enjoy a calm and structured wildlife adventure these holidays. With dedicated 1:1 support, participants step into the shoes of a zookeeper, meeting amazing animals up close, trying out new skills and building confidence in a safe and engaging space. The program provides a supportive environment where every participant can relax, have fun and connect with wildlife in a way that feels just right for them.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
- Sensory-friendly and inclusive — tailored specifically for NDIS participants with autism, focusing on comfort, support and accessibility.
- Real hands-on experience with a wide variety of native Australian animals — reptiles, birds, mammals, amphibians and more — offering a unique immersive wildlife encounter.
- Certificate and behind-the-scenes photos offer mementos of the experience.

- Hands-on zookeeping tasks (feeding, enriching, training, caring for animals).
- Certificate of participation.
- Behind-the-scenes photos access.

- The price does not explicitly include any transport to/from the venue. (Not mentioned.)
- Personal support for tasks like bathroom use or mental-health support beyond general supervision — participants are expected to manage independently.

1. Arrival at HQ in Burwood (2 Leslie Ct) at 9:30 AM.
2. Welcome briefing and introduction to staff / support worker.
3. Learning session — facts about native Australian wildlife: habitat, lifestyles, care in captivity.
4. Hands-on animal care: feeding, enrichment, cleaning/enclosure tasks, animal husbandry.
5. Closing — certificate award and behind-the-scenes photos.

- Phone or camera to take photos.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Take to the skies with Milford Sound Scenic Flights and discover the breathtaking beauty of Fiordland from above before joining the Milford Sound Classic Cruise through the heart of the fiord. This unforgettable fly-cruise-fly experience reveals New Zealand’s most iconic landscapes, towering peaks, cascading waterfalls, and remote alpine lakes. First from the air, then from the water. field_values.redo_desc_about:
What can you expect? To revolutionize how you ride on the trail. Over four weeks, our professional guides strip away your "survival" habits and replace them with proactive modern skills. We cover everything from the physics of modern body positioning and braking to the art of cornering flow and safer jumping progression.
By the end of the series, you will have a "toolbox" of skills that make any trail feel like home. This level of financial subsidy from ACC is a unique, one-off initiative designed to improve rider safety within our community; once these 50 spots are gone, the offer is over. As our graduates often say:
"The only thing you will complain about after the course is that you wish you had done it years earlier."
Saturday Series Dates: April 11, 18, 25, and May 2.
Sunday Series Dates: April 12, 19, 26, and May 3.
AM Sessions (10:00 AM – 12:00 PM): Intermediate Riders (Grade 3-4). Perfect for riders who are comfortable on blue trails but want to tackle more technical trails with features such as tigher corners, narrower trails, roots, and small drops.
PM Sessions (1:00 PM – 3:00 PM): Advanced Riders (Grade 4-5). Designed for riders looking to progress their riding to tackle Nelson's more demanding black-grade trails, which feature steeper chutes and dropping corners, and awkward roots and rocks.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
The Best Value Upgrade: Cheaper than most bike parts and lasts a lifetime.
Modern Techniques: Skills specifically designed for modern mountain bike geometry.
Professional Credentials: Gravity Nelson is Safety Audit Certified and NZOIA qualified.
Immediate Results: Tangible improvements in confidence and control from Session 1.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
4 x 2-hour coaching sessions with NZOIA-qualified professionals.
Small group environment (max 7:1 ratio).
Personalized feedback and technical video analysis (where appropriate).
ACC-subsidised pricing ($125 total for the 4-week series).
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded:
Mountain bike and helmet (Rental options available at Gravity Nelson).
Shuttle fees (if required for specific trail locations).
Food and personal hydration.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
Session 1: Modern Body Position & Braking. Learn how modern geometry works with your body to create stability and effective, smooth stopping power.
Session 2: Cornering & Traction. Learn to lean the bike and maintain speed through Nelson’s switchbacks and berms without fighting the steering.
Session 3: Drops & Jumps. A systematic approach to leaving the ground and landing safely using proven progression techniques.
Session 4: Integration & Flow. Putting all the skills together on technical trails to ensure you continue to progress long after the course ends.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Please arrive at the meeting point 15 minutes before your scheduled session time. Ensure your bike is in good working order and your helmet is correctly fitted. Ideally bring knee pads and mountain bike specific shoes.
field_values.redo_desc_duration_text: 8 hours total (Comprised of 4 x 2-hour weekly sessions).
field_values.redo_desc_requirements:
Participants must have a basic level of fitness to ride for 2 hours and be comfortable riding Grade 3 (Intermediate) trails.
This course is aimed at Adult Riders (18+), check out our other offerings for kids and youth specific courses.
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: Full Refund if Cancelled One or more weeks before the Course, otherwise 50% refund.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Please arrive at the meeting point 15 minutes before your scheduled session time. Ensure your bike is in good working order and your helmet is correctly fitted. Ideally bring knee pads and mountain bike specific shoes.
field_values.redo_desc_other: Gravity Nelson has rental mountain bikes available if you need.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Private overnight charter to idyllic Horseshoe Bay at Peel Island — sheltered white sands and shallow waters that attract dolphins, sea turtles, fish and birdlife. This destination is only accessible by watercraft. Enjoy swimming, paddle boards, the large floating sea mat and sea biscuiting. The tender can take you onto the beach and you can enjoy lunch on the water’s edge or on the sand for a relaxing reset.
restrictions: - Guests are welcome to bring their own food, beverages, personal chefs and entertainment (contact details required)
- No shoes onboard (storage provided at boarding)
- No food or drink in the cabins
- Jumping off the bow or roof is not permitted
- Sea biscuit: must remain seated holding grip handles; standing is not permitted
- All routes, activities and schedules are subject to weather, tides and marine conditions to ensure guest safety
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
- Sheltered bay with white sands and shallow water
- Dolphin, turtle and marine life spotting
- Tender beach drop-offs available
- Relaxing destination only accessible by boat
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
- Lunch: fruit platter + wrap platter box + antipasto platter box + sweet treat
- Dinner: onboard BBQ dinner (steak/chicken, salads & rolls) + Magnum ice creams
- Breakfast: toast, spreads, yoghurt, cereal (muesli/sultana bran/coco pops), seasonal fruit, juice, milk (full cream/oat/almond), tea (English breakfast/herbal), coffee
- Snacks: potato chips, nuts, muesli bars, ice blocks
- Beer fridge: champagne x2, beer box 24 x1, soft drinks, 350ml bottled still water, 350ml bottled sparkling water
- Morning wake-up, breakfast and optional swim (crew discretion and daylight).
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
- Arrive and check-in at Raby Bay Jetty (please arrive early for boarding).
- Board the vessel and participate in the safety briefing.
- Cruise to Peel Island (approx. 40 minutes travel time).
- Anchor at Horseshoe Bay.
- Enjoy swimming and water sports (paddle boards, sea mat, sea biscuiting).
- Enjoy lunch on the water and relax onboard with music and views.
- Sunset session: unwind on the bow cushions and enjoy the changing sky colours.
- Dinner: onboard BBQ dinner (included for catered option; see food & beverage details).
- Overnight stay onboard with full liveaboard amenities.
- Return cruise to Raby Bay Jetty and disembark.

Children must have parental supervision at all times. If you have more children onboard than adults, you are required to bring a minder/minders.

field_values.redo_desc_about: This fully private Martinborough Wine Day Tour is curated around your interests with personalised guidance from an expert wine educator. Beginning with morning pickup, your day typically includes around five vineyard visits, expert-led tastings across the Martinborough wine region, and a relaxed vineyard lunch showcasing local cuisine and wines. The tour is designed to offer deep insight into the region’s winemaking and terroir, with intimate access to standout producers and a comfortable pace that lets you savour each visit. Drop-off is by mid-afternoon at your accommodation or nominated location.

- Personalised private wine touring experience
- Deep local knowledge from qualified wine guide
- Multiple boutique vineyard tastings
- Relaxed vineyard lunch among wine country scenery
- Flexible itinerary based on your preferences

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Craving an island escape without the travel time? This unforgettable Sydney experience brings the getaway to you. Take to the skies on a thrilling highlights flight, soaring across the sparkling harbour and out to the iconic sweep of Bondi Beach before touching down for the next chapter of your adventure.
From there, a water taxi whisks you away to the secluded beauty of Shark Island- your own slice of paradise in the heart of Sydney Harbour. Unpack a decadent picnic hamper, lay out your rug, and soak up panoramic harbour views that feel worlds away from the everyday.
In the picnic hamper you will find focaccia bread, hummus, taramasalata, fruits, nuts, Burrata, king fish, marinated salad, arancini, crab toast, sweet treats as well as water, soft drinks and a house wine.
When you’re ready, glide back across the water at your leisure by boat, returning to Sydney Seaplanes restaurant with memories of a truly elevated escape- no passport required!

field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
Sydney Highlights scenic flight
Fly by of Bondi Beach
Scenic loop over Harbour Bridge and Opera House
Aerial views of Harbourside mansions
Return to land at Rose Bay
Picnic hamper with wine
Return water taxi transfers to and from Shark island
field_values.redo_desc_requirements:
This trip involves a boat transfer from seaplane to dock at the destination, therefore passengers must have a reasonable degree of mobility to attend, i.e. climb and descend seaplane stairs, step from seaplane into boat and vice versa.
This experience is very weather dependent. To avoid disappointment, please keep in mind that flights only proceed if weather conditions are suitable. The decision to fly will be made by Chief Pilot on the day based on the aviation forecast.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Explore the stunning Freycinet National Park on this full-day adventure from Hobart. Discover the world-famous Wineglass Bay, hike to the iconic lookout for breathtaking coastal views, and enjoy time to relax on pristine white-sand beaches. Along the way, experience dramatic granite peaks, crystal-clear waters, and abundant Tasmanian wildlife. This tour combines scenic walks, beach time, and guided insights into the region’s natural history, making it the perfect escape for nature lovers seeking one of Tasmania’s most celebrated landscapes.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
- Wineglass Bay Lookout offers one of Australia’s most iconic coastal views, overlooking turquoise waters and white sands framed by granite peaks.
- Freycinet National Park showcases dramatic landscapes, unique wildlife, and pristine beaches.
- Enjoy a rewarding coastal hike with panoramic views and fresh Tasmanian air.
- Relax on the white sands of Wineglass Bay, consistently ranked among the world’s best beaches.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
DAY ONE - Arrive in the breathtaking wilderness of Tasmania and journey to the iconic Freycinet National Park—where turquoise waters meet rugged pink granite peaks.
- We’ll take care of the logistics, with optional transfers available from Launceston, so you can fully relax and step straight into adventure.
- Your journey begins with a spectacular coastal hike along Hazards Beach, where pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters set the tone for the days ahead.
- We continue on to the secluded beauty of Cooks Beach, where we’ll establish camp for the night. Along the way, enjoy a guided walk to the famous Wineglass Bay Lookout—your first glimpse of one of the world’s most iconic views.
- As the sun lowers, unwind with a refreshing swim, followed by a relaxed dinner by the beach under the Tasmanian sky.
DAY TWO - Rise early for an unforgettable climb to the summit of Mt Freycinet—rewarded with sweeping panoramic views across the peninsula and beyond.
- From here, we continue on to Mt Graham, where we’ll pause for a well-earned lunch overlooking the dramatic east coast.
- Descending towards Wineglass Bay, take time to relax on its pristine shores—swim, rest, and soak in the beauty of this truly special place.
- We then make our way back towards camp in the Wineglass Bay region for another peaceful evening. Enjoy free time to unwind, freshen up, and share a nourishing dinner with the group.
DAY THREE - On our final morning, we take on the exhilarating climb up Mt Amos—arguably the best vantage point over Wineglass Bay.
After soaking in the final views and capturing those unforgettable moments, we return to camp, pack up, and begin our journey home—leaving with a sense of achievement, connection, and lasting memories of Tasmania’s wild beauty.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Participants should have a moderate level of fitness suitable for uphill walking. Not suitable for those with limited mobility or serious medical conditions affecting hiking ability.
