- Descending towards Wineglass Bay, take time to relax on its pristine shores—swim, rest, and soak in the beauty of this truly special place.

- We then make our way back towards camp in the Wineglass Bay region for another peaceful evening. Enjoy free time to unwind, freshen up, and share a nourishing dinner with the group.

DAY THREE - On our final morning, we take on the exhilarating climb up Mt Amos—arguably the best vantage point over Wineglass Bay.

After soaking in the final views and capturing those unforgettable moments, we return to camp, pack up, and begin our journey home—leaving with a sense of achievement, connection, and lasting memories of Tasmania’s wild beauty.
highlights: - Wineglass Bay Lookout offers one of Australia’s most iconic coastal views, overlooking turquoise waters and white sands framed by granite peaks.
- Freycinet National Park showcases dramatic landscapes, unique wildlife, and pristine beaches.
- Enjoy a rewarding coastal hike with panoramic views and fresh Tasmanian air.
- Relax on the white sands of Wineglass Bay, consistently ranked among the world’s best beaches.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Enjoy a 10 minute hands-on encounter and learn about these fascinating Apex Predators. The Dingo encounter at our wildlife park offers visitors a unique opportunity to observe and interact with these fascinating creatures in a safe and controlled environment. Dingoes are native to Australia, and are known for their intelligence and agility, making them a popular attraction for wildlife enthusiasts. During the dingo encounter experience, visitors have the chance to learn about the biology and behavior of dingoes from our expert guides. Our dingo encounter is designed to provide an educational and enriching experience for visitors. Whether you are a seasoned wildlife enthusiast, or just curious about these iconic Australian animals, the dingo encounter is sure to leave a lasting impression. By participating in the dingo encounter, visitors not only gain a deeper understanding of these unique creatures but also support our conservation efforts to ensure the protection and preservation of dingoes for future generations. We invite you to join us for a memorable dingo encounter experience at our wildlife park.

Eden Valley's signature varieties are Riesling and Shiraz, but the region also produces Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon, Chardonnay. Pinot Gris, cabernet Savignon,and Merlot, which are among the best wines in Australia. The region is home to some of the world's oldest Shiraz and Riesling Vineyards, and the 5th generation winemakers with links back to the area's original settlers still make wine using the same techniques as their forefathers. Let us Show you an amazing day exploring this unique region.

An artist facilitator leads the group through creating a complete painting from start to finish. Each stage is demonstrated clearly, with time to ask questions, adjust and personalise the work. Teams are encouraged to enjoy the process, chat as they go and add small touches that reflect their own style. Refreshments can be included if appropriate to the event.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Snorkelling is a fun, relaxing and exciting activity that allows you to become a part of a fascinating underwater world. Each snorkelling experience provides opportunities to explore, learn and grow as you as you begin to understand the complex relationships occurring in the marine ecosystems encountered. ACWA’s team will set you up with high quality equipment and expert local advice. As such, you will have the confidence to explore the Jervis Bay Marine Park conformably at your own pace. We provide helpful tips, resources and on-going support to ensure you have a successful self-guided snorkelling adventure.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights: Snorkelling equipment hire is an ideal option for the self-sufficient traveller or group. The hire option removes the need to carry excess equipment whilst travelling and lets you explore at your own pace. With a few helpful tips and a sense of adventure you can explore the abundant underwater environment of the South Coast in your own time with the assistance of an expert local guide at your finger tips.

- Contact ACWA and advise staff your size for wetsuits and fins
- Pick up equipment from ACWA staff where you will be given a demonstration on how to use it and tips on some of our favourite snorkelling sites
- Drop off equipment after snorkelling
(Pick up and drop off site will be advised over the phone)

Wetsuit sizes range from Children's size 12- Adult 5XL
Fins sizes range from 1-15

field_values.redo_desc_about: This one-hour Mangrove + Broadwater Jet Boat Tour balances peaceful exploration and high-energy jet boating. Glide through winding mangrove channels and narrow creeks while your skipper shares local knowledge about the environment, wildlife and tidal systems. Then open out into the Broadwater for powerful acceleration, sweeping turns and controlled manoeuvres against a backdrop of skyline and sandbanks. The contrast between tranquil mangrove cruising and dynamic Broadwater runs offers a varied, well-paced hour on the water for families, first-time riders and adventure seekers.

* Explore winding mangrove creeks and sheltered waterways
* Experience high-performance jet boat manoeuvres in the Broadwater
* Enjoy contrasting scenery from tranquil mangroves to open channels
* Suitable for families and first-time jet boat riders

## Be Ready for Pick up

Pick up from the Byron Bay area happen between 11am and 12pm. If you haven't selected your pick up point yet, no drama! Get in touch 48 Hours prior to your tour departure date and we'll confirm your pick up time. For addresses outside of our pick up area, we will ask you to get closer so that the tour can commence on time. 

Be on time! we'll always do our best to contact you by mobile phone if you are late or missing part of the tour. Guests who miss any part of the tour for any reason will not be eligible for a refund. 

------------------------
## What to Bring
Please bring a photo ID. All passengers must be 18+ to participate

--------------------
## Good to know
 - Since the tour has a minimum of 2 people, you may hear from our team if the minimum booking number hasn't been reached. We'll call 48H before your tour if this is the case and accommodate you the best we can!

--------------------
## Special Needs 
Behind the Barrel Byron Bay welcomes passengers with special needs or disabilities. Please let us know in advance of any physical, medical or other special requirements as not all locations may have the required facilities or access.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Our Afterschool Surfing Program is the perfect way for kids and teens to develop their surf skills and ocean confidence in a structured and supportive environment. Running for 6 consecutive weeks, kids join the same class each week at Sumner Beach, with multiple time slots to suit your schedule. Whether your child is brand new to surfing or already catching waves, this program is designed to progress their skills week by week with fun and achievement at every stage.
We offer a 10% off surfer discount for boards and wetsuits from our surf shop.
faqs: #Does my child need to be able to to swim?
Your surfer will be in waist depth water with their feet on the ocean sand.
We operate rain or shine and always run safe and fun surf lessons.
If we feel the ocean is not suitable we will reschedule if your scheduel allows.
If the conditions are not suitable for your equipment, you can use ours!
We have highly experienced and qualified surf instructors, first aid trained and surf rescue awarded.
We operate a target max ratio of 1 instructor to 6 surfers.
However we provide extra care with younger or more vulnerable surfers
Absolutely this is our specialty, we have experience with a big array of learning, behavioral and emotional learning challenges.
Should your child have a serious limiting physical difficulty preventing then from being active, we recommend contacting us to discuss

Our Afterschool Surfing Program is the perfect way for kids and teens to develop their surf skills and ocean confidence in a structured and supportive environment.

Running for 6 consecutive weeks, kids join the same class each week at Sumner Beach, with multiple time slots to suit your schedule. 

Whether your child is brand new to surfing or already catching waves, this program is designed to progress their skills week by week with fun and achievement at every stage.

#Sumner Beach

Tuesdays, Wednesdays, or Thursdays after school:

4:00–5:15pm - Primary & Intermediate students
5:15–6:30pm - High School & College students

Saturday Mornings:

9:00am - Primary & Intermediate students
10.15am - High School & College students

- Warm-up and stretch on the beach
- Daily focus: new skill or technique each week (e.g. pop-up, turning, paddling, wave selection)
- Supervised in-water coaching and practice
- End-of-session recap and feedback
highlights: - Progressive surf coaching with Bronze, Silver, Gold & Platinum awards.
- Small group sizes for personalised instruction.
- Builds surf technique, water safety, confidence & friendships.
- New in 2025/26: Enhanced learning levels and medal achievements.
- All gear provided or bring your own!
check_in_details: Please plan your travel and arrive 10 minutes before your lesson so not to be late. Our instructors will be available right on the start of your lesson time
extras: We regularly have parents ask us about buying surfboards and wetsuits after the program. Talk to us about what's best. We offer a 10% off surfer discount for boards and wetsuits from our surf shop.
faqs: #Does my child need to be able to to swim?
We welcome poor swimmers. Your surfer will be in waist depth water with their feet on the ocean sand.

#What about bad weather?
We operate rain or shine and always run safe and fun surf lessons. We hardly ever cancel lessons. If we feel the ocean is not suitable we will reschedule if your scheduel allows.

#Can my surfer bring their own surfboard and wetsuit?
All surfboards and wetsuits are provided however we encourage you to bring your own equipment if you have it.
If the conditions are not suitable for your equipment, you can use ours!

#What does your supervision look like?
We have highly experienced and qualified surf instructors, first aid trained and surf rescue awarded.
We operate a target max ratio of 1 instructor to 6 surfers. However we provide extra care with younger or more vulnerable surfers

#My child has learning or physical difficulties? Can they still join?
Absolutely this is our specialty, we have experience with a big array of learning, behavioral and emotional learning challenges. Should your child have a serious limiting physical difficulty preventing then from being active, we recommend contacting us to discuss

Enjoy an hour in the cockpit of VH-OJA hosted by a pilot who will explain the cockpit in detail and will take you through normal and non-normal procedures. Sit in the front seat and actually handle the controls. Each tour is limited to two guests. HARS has an exclusive 747 cockpit experience available on our 747-438, VH-OJA. OJA holds the record as the first passenger aircraft to fly from London to Sydney non stop. Tours will be conducted by a 747 pilot who will tell you what really happens at the pointy end of these magnificent aircraft.
In addition to your Cockpit Tour, step out onto the wing of one of our historic aircraft and enjoy a truly unique perspective of the museum.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Wander through beautifully preserved Victorian streets, browse boutique designer stores, and uncover local treasures at your own pace. Indulge your senses with tastings of locally made honey, artisan chocolate, and small-batch gin, each offering a true taste of the region. For a step back in time, explore the fascinating Cobblestones Museum and experience early settler life brought to life.
With its perfect mix of culture, cuisine, and character, this Greytown Discovery experience is a relaxed yet enriching journey you won’t want to miss.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
- Honey Tasting Experience – Enjoy a guided tasting at Greytown Honey, sampling a range of premium local honeys.
- Chocolate Indulgence – Treat yourself to handcrafted delights at Schoc Chocolates, Greytown’s beloved local chocolatier.
- Freetime exploration – Wander through beautifully preserved Victorian streets, browse boutique designer stores, and uncover local treasures at your own pace.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: These optional experiences are seasonal, at your own expense, and subject to availability. Advance bookings may be required, and our team is happy to assist in arranging these to ensure a seamless visit.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
**10:00 AM – Depart Wellington City**
Begin your gourmet adventure with a scenic drive northeast from central Wellington. Travel through the picturesque Hutt Valley and climb over the dramatic Remutaka Ranges while your driver guide shares stories and insights about the region’s history, culture, and natural beauty.
**10:45 AM – Remutaka Summit Stop (555m)**
Pause at the summit lookout to take in breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding ranges and valleys — a perfect photo opportunity before descending into the Wairarapa region.
**11:15-11:45 – Greytown Honey**
Enjoy a guided tasting at Greytown Honey, sampling a range of premium local honeys. Discover unique flavour profiles shaped by New Zealand’s landscapes and learn how honey is crafted from hive to jar.
**11:45 - 13:30 – Exploration of Greytown (at your own choice)**
You’ll then enjoy approximately 1.5 hours of free time exploring the charm of Greytown at your own pace. Choose to indulge in a boutique gin or wine tasting, visit a local olive grove or cidery for a guided experience, or wander through a fragrant lavender farm in bloom.
If you’re feeling peckish, relax at one of Greytown’s inviting cafés for lunch, or browse the village’s eclectic mix of boutique and vintage shops for something truly unique.
**13:30 - 14:00 – Chocolate Tasting at Schoc Chocolates, Greytown**
Head to the nearby boutique town of Greytown, known for its elegant shops and heritage charm. Visit Schoc Chocolates to sample hand-crafted artisan chocolates made by renowned chocolatier Murray Langham, featuring both classic and inventive flavour combinations.
**14:00 – Scenic Return to Wellington**
Relax on the return journey as you retrace your route over the Remutaka Ranges, following the scenic Remutaka incline back to Wellington.
**15:30 – Arrive in Wellington City Centre**
Your tour concludes back in central Wellington — enriched, relaxed, and inspired by a day of delicious discoveries.

$2,800 for 2 passengers
Perched high above the dramatic coastline of Whale Beach, Jonah’s is an iconic clifftop retreat where refined luxury meets uninterrupted Pacific Ocean views. Steeped in history and renowned for its hatted restaurant, it offers a rare blend of world-class dining, boutique accommodation, and timeless coastal elegance.
For the ultimate overnight escape, arrive in style with a mid-afternoon seaplane departure from Rose Bay and step into a world of relaxed indulgence. After check-in, settle into your Ocean Retreat room- beautifully refurbished to create a serene coastal sanctuary, featuring handcrafted king-size A.H. Beard beds, floor-to-ceiling windows, and limestone bathrooms with spa baths designed for total relaxation.
Spend your afternoon unwinding to the rhythm of the ocean from your private balcony, or indulge in the thoughtful luxuries throughout your stay.
As evening falls, enjoy the world-class dining at Jonah’s restaurant, where exceptional cuisine is matched only by the sweeping ocean backdrop. Wake the next morning to the sound of waves rolling in, and if you’re an early riser, take in a spectacular sunrise over Whale Beach from your room.
Your experience concludes with a midday seaplane departure with a scenic flight over Sydney Harbour at 12pm- leaving you refreshed, restored, and carrying the memory of a truly unforgettable coastal retreat.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
Dine & Stay package
Pack your getaway bag for a mid-afternoon flight from our Seaplane Terminal at Rose Bay.
After check in at Jonah’s, take in the breeze from your private balcony and soak up the spectacular ocean views.
Choose 3-courses from the seasonal menu of contemporary Australian cuisine for dinner.
The next day, you will be picked up for your return seaplane flight at 12pm after breakfast to take in the circuit over Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House.
Available Thursday-Saturday

field_values.redo_desc_about: Guba Markay Dance Team are Torres Strait Islanders, the First Nations People of Australia. The third generation carrying forward the stories, dances, and songlines of the seven clan groups of Saibai Island. Each performance reflects our deep connection to culture, identity, and the ongoing preservation of Bamaga traditions within the Northern Peninsula Area. Please note: this is a family and alcohol-free event.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
Guba Markay was established in 1990. It is a proud Bamaga Traditional Dance Group, showcasing the movement, history, and cultural legacy of people who relocated from Saibai Island in the Torres Strait to Muttee Head, mainland Australia in 1947. Through our performances we honour the strength and resilience of our Elders and ancestors.
Our achievements include the Gold Winners 2020 Sydney Dance Rites, Gold Laura Festival 2018, Gold Weipa Cultural Festival 1995 and many more. We perform at festivals and deliver a full cultural experience showcasing our seven clan stories and ancestral movements.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included:
Visitors will be introduced to the Kala Lagaw Ya language, one of the traditional languages of the Torres Strait, through guided storytelling sessions. These stories share knowledge of the Tagai constellation, seasonal changes, island life, and cultural values passed down through generations. This creates a meaningful opportunity for visitors to not just observe, but understand the worldview and knowledge systems of Torres Strait Islander people.
The experience is further enriched through traditional island food tasting, where guests can sample local foods such as fresh seafood, damper, coconut-based dishes, and other culturally significant ingredients. These tastings highlight the strong relationship between people, sea country, and sustainable practices.
Visitors can also purchase authentic arts and crafts, including hand-made items such as woven baskets, carvings, jewellery, and cultural artefacts created by local artists. Each piece carries cultural meaning and provides a direct way to support local creators and keep traditions strong.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: We offer a rich and immersive cultural tourism experience that invites visitors to connect deeply with the living traditions of the Northern Peninsula Area (NPA) and the Torres Strait. At the heart of this experience is traditional Torres Strait Islander dance, where powerful storytelling is expressed through movement, rhythm, and song, reflecting connection to land, sea, ancestors, and identity. The Northern Peninsula Area (NPA) is the gateway to the stunning Torres Strait Islands, known as Zenadth Kes.

field_values.redo_desc_about: This 30-minute scenic flight showcases the dramatic sandstone massif of the Bungle Bungle Range and its striking landforms. From the aircraft you’ll see hidden red rock gorges at the park’s north-west tip and Horseshoe Valley, then soar over Piccaninny Gorge and Cathedral Gorge. The highlight is the banded Bungle Bungle domes—an unforgettable aerial view of features that helped secure Purnululu’s World Heritage listing.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Nothing tastes better than fruit picked straight from the tree - and we’ll show you why in our Pick Your Own persimmon experience. Persimmons are a true seasonal treat, available for a limited time each year. Our persimmon varieties can be enjoyed both crisp like an apple, or when ripe and soft. If you've never tried one, they're often described as tasting like a mix of apricot, rock melon and mango - they’re sweet, smooth, and unlike anything you’ll find in the supermarket, making this a unique experience not to be missed. Wander through the orchard, pick your own fruit, and enjoy the simple pleasure of eating it fresh among the trees. Along the way, you’ll learn a little about how our fruit is grown, while soaking up a beautiful farm setting perfect for relaxed, candid moments.
They’ll soften slightly over time if left on the bench, becoming even sweeter.
Enjoy them fresh, sliced into salads, or added to desserts.
field_values.redo_desc_what_excluded: Picked fruit is weighed and paid for at the end of the experience at the current market rate.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Please arrive at least 15 minutes prior to your booked session time to allow for check-in. You’ll begin with a short safety and biosecurity briefing, before hopping aboard our Orchard Explorer tractor train for a short ride out to the persimmons. There is a short walk down a hill to the persimmon trees. Once you arrive in the orchard, we’ll show you how to select and pick the best fruit. You’ll then be free to explore and pick your own persimmons at your own pace. When you’re finished, we'll hop back on the Orchard Explorer and return to the farm shop to weigh and pay for your harvest.

description: ###Duration
60 minutes (approx)

###About
Nothing tastes better than fruit picked straight from the tree - and we’ll show you why in our Pick Your Own persimmon experience.

Persimmons are a true seasonal treat, available for a limited time each year. Our persimmon varieties can be enjoyed both crisp like an apple, or when ripe and soft. If you've never tried one, they're often described as tasting like a mix of apricot, rock melon and mango - they’re sweet, smooth, and unlike anything you’ll find in the supermarket, making this a unique experience not to be missed.

Wander through the orchard, pick your own fruit, and enjoy the simple pleasure of eating it fresh among the trees. Along the way, you’ll learn a little about how our fruit is grown, while soaking up a beautiful farm setting perfect for relaxed, candid moments.

###Here’s how it works on the day:
Please arrive at least 15 minutes prior to your booked session time to allow for check-in.
You’ll begin with a short safety and biosecurity briefing, before hopping aboard our Orchard Explorer tractor train for a short ride out to the persimmons.
There is a short walk down a hill to the persimmon trees. 
Once you arrive in the orchard, we’ll show you how to select and pick the best fruit. You’ll then be free to explore and pick your own persimmons at your own pace.
Fruit is charged per kilogram at the current market rate, so please only pick what you wish to take home.
When you’re finished, we'll hop back on the Orchard Explorer and return to the farm shop to weigh and pay for your harvest.

###What to bring:
• Enclosed shoes (no crocs, slides, sandals or thongs - wear shoes that are ok to get muddy)
• Bags for your fruit
• Weather-appropriate clothing, including a hat
• Sunscreen
• Water bottle
• A charged phone or camera

###Important information - please read before booking:
• Enclosed shoes are required. Guests without appropriate footwear will be unable to join the tour
• Tours depart at the scheduled time. Please allow at least 15 minutes for check-in - late arrivals cannot be accommodated
• Picked fruit is weighed and paid for at the end of the experience at the current market rate
• Bookings are essential. Sessions often sell out and are limited by tractor capacity
• For biosecurity reasons, please do not bring any external fruit or vegetables into the orchard

###A quick tip for enjoying your persimmons:
Our persimmons can be enjoyed while still firm, like an apple, with a crisp texture and sweet flavour. They’ll soften slightly over time if left on the bench, becoming even sweeter. Enjoy them fresh, sliced into salads, or added to desserts.

Pre: Arrive Friday late afternoon / evening at Home Station Lodge at your leisure.
Day 1: Enjoy a cooked breakfast before departing Home Station Lodge for a short drive to our high country farming property that’s been in the Watson family for many generations.
We ride up to spectacular 360 degree views and along the way, watch out for the wildlife that often takes a look at us, including kangaroos, wallabies and the amazing bird life.
We enjoy a BBQ lunch at our hut. After lunch we ride into the Dungeon Gully and loop around to Home Station lodge on horseback.
Enjoy a relaxing hot shower before a hearty dinner in one of Victoria’s prettiest valleys.
Day 2: We enjoy a country breakfast that gives you a big energy boost before we ride.
We then set off for “Kate Camerons Peak” where we see the perilously steep hill where the famous jump scene from the movie was filmed. We then descend back down to the farm to complete our ride.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Climb above Queenstown on a private, fully guided hike to the 1,748 m Ben Lomond summit. Begin with Skyline Gondola access, then traverse beech forest and alpine tussock as your guide sets the pace to match your fitness. Enjoy panoramic 360° views over Lake Wakatipu, the Remarkables and the Southern Alps, plus a gourmet trail lunch and included transfers. This challenging but rewarding day is tailored for active hikers seeking a personalised alpine experience with professional safety gear and guidance.
disclaimers: Alpine weather can change quickly; guides may alter the route or turn back for safety.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
* Start with a scenic Skyline Gondola ride, skipping the lower climb.
* Summit 1,748 m for 360° views across Lake Wakatipu and the Southern Alps.
* Private guide offering personalized pace, local insights and safety supervision.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: Gourmet trail lunch and included transfers.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
1. 8:00 am hotel pickup in Queenstown and transfer to the Skyline Gondola.
2. Gondola ride to the trailhead and start the hike through alpine tussock.
3. Hike 2–3 hours to Ben Lomond Saddle.
4. Ascend 1–2 hours from the saddle to the 1,748 m summit; enjoy lunch with panoramic views.
5. Descend the same route to the gondola and ride down.
6. Transfer back to your Queenstown hotel; total experience about 7–8 hours.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: Participants should be active hikers with good fitness due to a steady 950 m climb over approximately 11 km return.
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Pickup at 8:00 am from your Queenstown hotel; transfers to and from the Skyline Gondola are included.

Enjoy panoramic 360° views over Lake Wakatipu, the Remarkables and the Southern Alps, plus a gourmet trail lunch and included transfers. This challenging but rewarding day is tailored for active hikers seeking a personalised alpine experience with professional safety gear and guidance.
itinerary: 1. 8:00 am hotel pickup in Queenstown and transfer to the Skyline Gondola.
2. Gondola ride to the trailhead and start the hike through alpine tussock.
3. Hike 2–3 hours to Ben Lomond Saddle.
4. Ascend 1–2 hours from the saddle to the 1,748 m summit; enjoy lunch with panoramic views.
5. Descend the same route to the gondola and ride down.
6. Transfer back to your Queenstown hotel; total experience about 7–8 hours.
highlights: * Start with a scenic Skyline Gondola ride, skipping the lower climb.
* Summit 1,748 m for 360° views across Lake Wakatipu and the Southern Alps.
* Private guide offering personalized pace, local insights and safety supervision.
check_in_details: Pickup at 8:00 am from your Queenstown hotel; transfers to and from the Skyline Gondola are included.
special_requirements: Participants should be active hikers with good fitness due to a steady 950 m climb over approximately 11 km return.
disclaimers: Alpine weather can change quickly; guides may alter the route or turn back for safety. Total hiking time is approximately 5–7 hours within a 7–8 hour experience. Departures run November–April.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Experience the best of Fiordland in one unforgettable day. Depart Queenstown in a private vehicle with a personal guide, travel the spectacular Milford Road, and take a short native-forest nature walk. Cruise the full length of Milford Sound beneath dramatic cliffs and waterfalls, then finish with a fixed-wing scenic flight back over the Southern Alps, offering aerial views of peaks, glaciers, and alpine lakes. This private guided trip highlights Fiordland’s iconic landscapes in comfort and style.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights:
* Private vehicle travel along Milford Road
* Full-length Milford Sound cruise with wildlife and waterfalls
* Scenic flight return offering aerial views of peaks and glaciers
* Personal guide and private group experience
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
1. Begin the private guided journey from Queenstown into Fiordland National Park via Milford Road.
2. Enjoy an immersive Fiordland nature walk through native forest.
3. Continue to Milford Sound for a scenic nature cruise beneath cliffs and waterfalls.
4. Conclude with a scenic flight back to Queenstown over the Southern Alps.

field_values.redo_desc_about: The Reef Specialists offer an immersive, hour-long aerial exploration of the Great Barrier Reef, showcasing coastal landmarks and a chain of iconic reef formations. field_values.redo_desc_about: In this new series of weeknight masterclasses we're luring some exciting chef talent out of their restaurants and into the Sydney Seafood School kitchen. Seafood specialist and head chef at North Bondi Fish, David Coumont's cooking is guided by simplicity, seasonality, respect for produce and a desire to showcase lesser-known seafood species. Originally trained as a graphic designer, David changed direction in his late twenties and began his culinary training in Belgium. His first restaurant role was at Bozar in Brussels, now a two-Michelin-star restaurant. He went on to gain experience at leading European kitchens, including Maison Bras in Laguiole, before moving to Australia. In Sydney, he worked at The Woods, Fish Face alongside Stephen Hodges and Josh Niland, then spent time at Café Paci. In 2015, he opened Moxhe in Bronte, a small seafood-focused restaurant inspired by Australian produce and his Belgian background. At Moxhe, David visited the Sydney Fish Market each morning and adapted the menu around the best seasonal fish available that day. After eight years at Moxhe, he became Head Chef of North Bondi Fish, bringing his market-driven seafood approach to one of Sydney’s best-known beachside restaurants. This class will celebrate the diversity of Australian seafood in a way that is fresh, relaxed and deeply connected to the ocean. And a little bit of fun too.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: Our experiences are all-inclusive – just bring yourself and wear enclosed shoes to protect your feet, and maybe a pen to note down some insider cooking tips! field_values.redo_desc_about:
*** During May, June and July 2026, the Robin Boyd Foundation will engage in a significant project restoring the Boyd House II/Walsh Street facade and front staircase. During this time scaffolding will be present in the front garden and access may be diverted via the side entrance. The residence’s interiors and courtyard access will not be affected by the works. *** Join us at Walsh Street for a talk with Millie Anderson and Jimmy Carter of [Office MI—JI] (https://mi-ji.com.au/) for a conversation exploring A Courtyard House, a light filled home designed around courtyard garden views, accessibility, and family life. The house reflects an approach grounded in care, clarity, and the rhythms of domestic life. The project balances future-focused planning with generous spaces for everyday living, artistic pursuits, and extended family gatherings. [Office MI—JI] (https://mi-ji.com.au/) was established in Melbourne, but took shape in London and Chicago. With a clear motto of “do good work”, the office works with a straightforward motive that “good work” speaks for itself. A Courtyard House has been shortlisted for the 2026 Victorian Architecture Awards in the Residential Architecture – Houses (New) category.
As a heritage building, Walsh Street cannot be modified to achieve universal access.
This event is generously supported by [Royal Australian Institute of Architects](https://www.architecture.com.au/) [Brickworks Building Products](https://www.brickworks.com.au/), [Konpira Maru Wines](https://konpiramaruwinecompany.com/) and [Yumbo Soda](https://www.yumbosoda.com/).

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Join us for a relaxed series of seasonal events celebrating great flavours, local community and unforgettable evenings at Tūpari. Each session brings together a unique theme whether it’s curated wine pairings, shared feasts, live music, long lunches or special guest experiences designed to bring people together in a warm and welcoming setting. From casual gatherings to themed dining nights, Tūpari Locals Sessions are all about enjoying exceptional food and wine alongside good company in the heart of the vineyard.
Please book your group together or make a note on your booking to ensure you are seated together if you're a smaller group.
field_values.redo_desc_highlights: Love Thy Curry Night – June 26th. We're proud to be teaming up with Love Thy Curry, a locally owned business that shares our passion for bringing people together. Their delicious, authentic curries and commitment to quality make them a favourite with locals and the perfect partner for this winter feast. Enjoy a shared dining experience featuring three delicious curries served banquet-style across tables of up to eight guests.
field_values.redo_desc_what_included: Ticket includes: Three courses, one complimentary drink.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Doors open at 6:00pm with a complimentary glass of Tūpari wine on arrival, followed by nibbles from 6:30pm before the curry feast begins.

field_values.redo_desc_about: One-way ferry journey from Narcissus River Jetty to Cynthia Bay on Lake St Clair. Offering views of the lake and surrounding mountains along the way. This is the highest altitude ferry service in Australia and it operates on the deepest lake in Australia (approximately 160 metres deep).
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary: Passengers are required to arrive at least 10 minutes prior to departure. Depart from Narcissus River Jetty and cruise across Lake St Clair to Cynthia Bay.
field_values.redo_desc_what_to_bring: One backpack per passenger only. Sleeping bags securely strapped to packs are acceptable; however, no loose items are to be attached externally to bags. Please ensure walking poles are collapsed and stored with sharp ends facing inwards.
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: This experience may not be suitable for wheelchair users or passengers who require boarding assistance.
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: Cancellations made within 72 hours prior to departure time, or non-arrival, will incur a 100% cancellation fee.
field_values.redo_meeting_point: Narcissus River Jetty (departures from Narcissus River)
field_values.redo_desc_other: If you wish to make any changes to your booking, they must be made online no later than 72 hours prior to your scheduled departure. Passengers undertaking walking or hiking trips should ensure they are adequately prepared and are encouraged to check track and weather conditions with Tasmania Parks and Wildlife Service prior to departure. Certified guide dogs are welcome on board free of charge. For the comfort of all passengers, eating and drinking are not permitted on board.

field_values.redo_desc_about: Embrace the magic of winter at Sirromet Wines, where crisp evenings, rolling vineyard hills, and the glow of a private fire pit set the scene for an unforgettable escape. Wrap yourself in a picnic blanket, settle in beside the flames, as the estate transforms into a warm, flickering retreat. Each experience invites you to slow down, indulge, and savour the season—paired with thoughtfully curated grazing and your choice of premium Sirromet wines.

field_values.redo_desc_about:
Our most-loved experience, the full journey of manaakitanga (hosting and sharing), on the water and on foot.
A deeper Christchurch Waka-on-Avon experience where visitors become whānau.
Manaaki is our most-loved experience and the most immersive way to spend time with us. Over 75 minutes, you’ll warm up with an interactive kaihoe (paddle) game and kaihoe haka, paddle the Ōtākaro Avon River, then step ashore for a 15-minute guided heritage walk. Your kaiārahi shares mātauranga (Māori knowledge) and the stories of this place along the way. To manaaki is to uplift, encourage and care for others, and that is our commitment as your hosts.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
- A kaihoe (paddle) warm-up game and kaihoe haka
- A 75-minute guided waka journey plus a 15-minute heritage walk
- The journey from manuhiri (visitor) to whānau (family)
- Mātauranga (Māori knowledge) and storytelling shared along the way
- Time to slow down and connect, and more than a short introduction
field_values.redo_desc_requirements: An adult must be selected before adding a child or infant. We require a minimum supervision ratio of 1 adult to 2 children under 5, and 1 adult to 3 children aged 5–15. All children aged 15 and under must wear a life jacket. Life jackets are provided. You will need to sign a waiver in order to go on this experience. Minors will have our waiver signed by a supervising guardian.
field_values.redo_desc_cancellation: Bookings will be rescheduled or cancelled in advance if we do not meet a minimum of 4 passengers before the tour. This is a matter of health and safety, as well as your comfort!
field_values.redo_desc_check_in: Please arrive 10 minutes early

field_values.redo_desc_about:
A Cultural evening celebration on the Ōtākaro
Mātauraka (mātauranga) is knowledge, our deepest, most complete layer, shared after dark.
An evening on the Ōtākaro - cultural performance, kai and our deepest cultural stories, for your group.
Mātauraka is our evening showcase, created for groups, events and conferences. Over two hours, you’ll paddle the Ōtākaro at dusk, witness a live cultural performance by Pounamu Ngāi Tahu, and share a mahika kai – cultural food tasting. It is the deepest, most complete layer of our story, reserved for the evening, and for groups who want an occasion to remember.
field_values.redo_desc_itinerary:
- A waka journey on the Ōtākaro at dusk
- A live cultural performance by Ngāi Tūāhuriri
- A mahika kai tasting
- The deepest, most complete layer of our story, an evening occasion for groups
